title.zh: 卷三十五 志第十一 曆五
title.raw: 卷三十五 志第十一 曆五 Volume 35 Treatises 11: Calendar 5

sentences.zh: 志第十一 歷五

translations.literal: Treatise 11, Calendar 5.
translations.idiomatic: Treatise Eleven: Calendrics, Part Five.

sentences.zh: 大統曆法三上推步

translations.literal: Grand Concordance Calendar Method Three Upper: Stepwise Computation.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Grand Concordance Calendar Method, Part Three (Upper): Stepwise Computation.

sentences.zh: 大統推步，悉本《授時》，惟去消長而已。

translations.literal: Grand Concordance stepwise computation wholly takes the Season Granting as basis, only omitting expansion-contraction.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Concordance stepwise computation follows the Season Granting Calendar throughout, omitting only the solar expansion–contraction tables.

sentences.zh: 然《通軌》諸捷法，實爲布算所須，其間次序，亦有與《曆經》微別者。

translations.literal: Yet the Comprehensive Track's various shortcut methods are truly what spread calculation requires; their sequence also has slight differences from the Calendar Classic.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the shortcut procedures in the Comprehensive Track are indispensable for tabular computation, and their ordering also diverges slightly from the Calendar Classic.

sentences.zh: 如氣朔發斂，《授時》原分二章，今古合爲一。

translations.literal: Such as qi, new moon, issuing and gathering—Season Granting originally divided into two chapters; now ancient and modern are merged into one.
translations.idiomatic: Solar terms, lunations, and the issuing-and-gathering sequence, for example, formed two chapters in the Season Granting; here the older and newer treatments are combined into one.

sentences.zh: 《授時》盈縮差在日躔，遲疾差在月離，定朔、經朔離爲二處。

translations.literal: Season Granting placed expansion-contraction difference in solar motion and slow-rapid difference in lunar motion; mean new moon and true new moon were sought in two places.
translations.idiomatic: In the Season Granting, the equation of center belonged to solar motion and the anomaly to lunar motion, while mean and true conjunction were computed separately.

sentences.zh: 今則經朔後，即求定朔，於用殊便。

translations.literal: Now, after the mean new moon, true new moon is sought immediately—far more convenient in use.
translations.idiomatic: Here, once the mean conjunction is found, the true conjunction follows at once—a considerable practical advantage.

sentences.zh: 其目七：曰氣朔，曰日躔，曰月離，曰中星，曰交食，曰五星，曰四餘。

translations.literal: Its sections are seven: called qi and new moon, solar motion, lunar motion, culminating stars, crossing and eclipse, five planets, and four residues.
translations.idiomatic: There are seven sections: qi and lunation; solar motion; lunar motion; culminating stars; nodes and eclipses; the five planets; and the four residues.

sentences.zh: ▲步氣朔發斂附

translations.literal: ▲ Step qi, new moon, issuing and gathering attached
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Stepwise Computation: Qi, Lunation, and Issuing-and-Gathering (attached)

sentences.zh: 洪武十七年甲子歲爲元。

translations.literal: The seventeenth year of Hongwu, jiazi year, is taken as origin.
translations.idiomatic: The epoch is the jiazi year, Hongwu 17.

sentences.zh: 上距至元辛巳一百零四算。

translations.literal: Above, the interval to Zhiyuan xinsi is one hundred and four counts.
translations.idiomatic: The interval back to the Zhiyuan xinsi epoch is 104 counts.

sentences.zh: 歲週三百六十五萬二千四百二十五分，實測無消長。

translations.literal: Year circuit 3,652,425 fen; by actual measurement, without expansion-contraction.
translations.idiomatic: Tropical year length: 3,652,425 parts; by observation, without solar equation correction.

sentences.zh: 半之爲歲周，四分之爲氣象限，二十四分之爲氣策。

translations.literal: Halve it for year circuit; quarter it for qi image limit; divide by twenty-four for qi divisor.
translations.idiomatic: Halve it for the half-year circuit; quarter it for the qi-image limit; divide by twenty-four for the qi divisor.

sentences.zh: 日週一萬。

translations.literal: Day circuit ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Day unit: 10,000.

sentences.zh: 即一百刻，刻有百分，分有百秒，以下微纖，皆以百遞析。

translations.literal: That is one hundred ke; each ke has one hundred fen, each fen one hundred miao; below, the finest subdivisions all proceed by hundreds.
translations.idiomatic: That is one hundred quarter-hours; each quarter-hour has one hundred minutes, each minute one hundred seconds; finer subdivisions below all descend by hundreds.

sentences.zh: 氣應五十五萬零三百七十五分。

translations.literal: Qi response 550,375 fen.
translations.idiomatic: Qi offset: 550,375 parts.

sentences.zh: 置距算一百零四，求得中積三億七千六百一十九萬九千七百七十五分，加辛巳氣應五十五萬零六百分，得通積三億七千六百七十五萬零三百七十五分，滿紀法六十去之，餘爲《大統》氣應。

translations.literal: Set the interval count one hundred and four; obtain middle accumulation 376,199,775 fen; add xinsi qi response 550,600 fen, obtaining universal accumulation 376,750,375 fen; full era divisor sixty remove it; remainder is Grand Concordance qi response.
translations.idiomatic: Set the interval count at 104 to obtain a middle accumulation of 376,199,775 parts; add the xinsi qi offset of 550,600 parts for a universal accumulation of 376,750,375 parts; divide by the era divisor of 60 and take the remainder as the Grand Concordance qi offset.

sentences.zh: 開應一十八萬二千零百七十零分一十八秒。

translations.literal: Intercalation response 182,070 fen 18 miao.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalation offset: 182,070 parts 18 seconds.

sentences.zh: 置中積，加辛巳閏應二十零萬二千零五十分，得閏積三億七千六百四十零萬一千八百二十五分，滿朔實去之，餘爲《大統》閏應。

translations.literal: Set middle accumulation; add xinsi intercalation response 202,050 fen; obtain intercalation accumulation 376,401,825 fen; full new-moon divisor remove it; remainder is Grand Concordance intercalation response.
translations.idiomatic: Set the middle accumulation and add the xinsi intercalation offset of 202,050 parts to obtain an intercalation accumulation of 376,401,825 parts; divide by the synodic-month divisor and take the remainder as the Grand Concordance intercalation offset.

sentences.zh: 轉應二十零萬九千六百九十零分。

translations.literal: Rotation response 209,690 fen.
translations.idiomatic: Rotation offset: 209,690 parts.

sentences.zh: 置中積，加辛巳轉應一十三萬零二百零五分，共得三億七千六百三十二萬九千九百八十分，滿轉終去之，餘爲《大統》轉應。

translations.literal: Set middle accumulation; add xinsi rotation response 130,205 fen; together obtain 376,329,980 fen; full rotation cycle remove it; remainder is Grand Concordance rotation response.
translations.idiomatic: Set the middle accumulation and add the xinsi rotation offset of 130,205 parts, totaling 376,329,980 parts; divide by the rotation cycle and take the remainder as the Grand Concordance rotation offset.

sentences.zh: 交應一十一萬五千一百零五分零八秒。

translations.literal: Crossing response 115,105 fen 08 miao.
translations.idiomatic: Node offset: 115,105 parts 08 seconds.

sentences.zh: 置中積加辛巳交應二十六萬零三百八十八分，共得三億七千六百四十六萬零一百六十三分，滿交終去之，餘爲《大統》交應。

translations.literal: Set middle accumulation; add xinsi crossing response 260,388 fen; together obtain 376,460,163 fen; full crossing cycle remove it; remainder is Grand Concordance crossing response.
translations.idiomatic: Set the middle accumulation and add the xinsi node offset of 260,388 parts, totaling 376,460,163 parts; divide by the nodal cycle and take the remainder as the Grand Concordance node offset.

sentences.zh: 按《授時曆》既成之後，閏轉交三應數，旋有改定，故《元志》、《曆經》閏應二十零萬一千八百五十分，而《通軌》載閏應二十零萬二千零五十分，實加二百分，是當時經朔改早二刻也。

translations.literal: According to the Season Granting Calendar, after its completion the three response numbers for intercalation, rotation, and crossing were soon revised; hence the Yuan History and Calendar Classic give intercalation response 201,850 fen, while the Comprehensive Track records intercalation response 202,050 fen—actually adding 200 fen, which at the time advanced the mean new moon by two ke.
translations.idiomatic: After the Season Granting Calendar was completed, its intercalation, rotation, and node offsets were soon revised. The Yuan History and Calendar Classic give an intercalation offset of 201,850 parts, whereas the Comprehensive Track records 202,050 parts—an increase of 200 parts that then advanced the mean conjunction by two quarter-hours.

sentences.zh: 《曆經》轉應一十三萬一千九百零四分，《通軌》載轉應一十三萬零二百零五分，實減一千六百九十九分，是入轉改遲一十七刻弱也。

translations.literal: Calendar Classic rotation response 131,904 fen; Comprehensive Track records rotation response 130,205 fen—actually reducing 1,699 fen, which delayed entry into rotation by seventeen ke and a fraction.
translations.idiomatic: The Calendar Classic gives a rotation offset of 131,904 parts; the Comprehensive Track records 130,205 parts—a reduction of 1,699 parts that delayed nodal entry by seventeen quarter-hours and a fraction.

sentences.zh: 《曆經》交應二十六萬零一百八十七分八十六秒，《通軌》交應二十六萬零三百八十八分，實加二百分一十四秒，是正交改早二刻強也。

translations.literal: Calendar Classic crossing response 260,187 fen 86 miao; Comprehensive Track crossing response 260,388 fen—actually adding 200 fen 14 miao, which advanced true conjunction by two ke and a fraction.
translations.idiomatic: The Calendar Classic gives a node offset of 260,187 parts 86 seconds; the Comprehensive Track records 260,388 parts—an increase of 200 parts 14 seconds that advanced true conjunction by two quarter-hours and a fraction.

sentences.zh: 或以《通軌》辛巳三應，與《元志》互異，目爲元統所定，非也。

translations.literal: Some take the Comprehensive Track's xinsi three responses, differing from the Yuan History, and call them Yuan–Ming determinations—this is wrong.
translations.idiomatic: Some treat the Comprehensive Track's three xinsi offsets, which differ from the Yuan History, as Yuan–Ming revisions—this is mistaken.

sentences.zh: 夫改憲必由測驗，即當具詳始末，何反追改《授時曆》，自沒其勤乎？

translations.literal: Revising the calendar must proceed from measurement and verification; one ought then to set forth the whole course in detail—why instead retroactively alter the Season Granting Calendar and bury their labor?
translations.idiomatic: Calendar reform must rest on measurement and verification, and should then record the full course of events—why instead retroactively rewrite the Season Granting Calendar and efface their labor?

sentences.zh: 是故《通軌》所述者，乃《授時》續定之數，而《曆經》所存，則其未定之初藁也。

translations.literal: Therefore what the Comprehensive Track states are the Season Granting's subsequently fixed numbers, while what the Calendar Classic preserves is its initial, unfixed draft.
translations.idiomatic: Accordingly, the Comprehensive Track preserves the Season Granting's subsequently fixed constants, while the Calendar Classic retains its earlier, unfixed draft.

sentences.zh: 通餘五萬二千四百二十五分。

translations.literal: Universal remainder 52,425 fen.
translations.idiomatic: Universal remainder: 52,425 parts.

sentences.zh: 朔策二十九萬五千三百零五分九十三秒，一名朔寶。

translations.literal: New-moon divisor 295,305 fen 93 miao, also called new-moon constant.
translations.idiomatic: Synodic-month divisor: 295,305 parts 93 seconds, also called the synodic-month constant.

sentences.zh: 半之爲望策，一名交望。

translations.literal: Halve it for full-moon divisor, also called crossing full moon.
translations.idiomatic: Halve it for the full-moon divisor, also called the nodal full moon.

sentences.zh: 又半之爲弦策。

translations.literal: Halve again for quarter-moon divisor.
translations.idiomatic: Halve again for the quarter-moon divisor.

sentences.zh: 通閏一十零萬八千七百五十三分八十四秒。

translations.literal: Universal intercalation 108,753 fen 84 miao.
translations.idiomatic: Universal intercalation: 108,753 parts 84 seconds.

sentences.zh: 月閏九千零百六十二分八十二秒。

translations.literal: Month intercalation 9,062 fen 82 miao.
translations.idiomatic: Monthly intercalation unit: 9,062 parts 82 seconds.

sentences.zh: 閏限一十八萬六千五百五十二分零九秒。

translations.literal: Intercalation limit 186,552 fen 09 miao.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalation threshold: 186,552 parts 09 seconds.

sentences.zh: 一名閏準。

translations.literal: Also called intercalation standard.
translations.idiomatic: Also called the intercalation criterion.

sentences.zh: 盈初縮末限八十八萬九千零百九十二分二十五秒。

translations.literal: Expansion-initial contraction-final limit 889,092 fen 25 miao.
translations.idiomatic: Expansion-initial and contraction-final interval: 889,092 parts 25 seconds.

sentences.zh: 縮初盈末限九十三萬七千一百二十零分二十五秒。

translations.literal: Contraction-initial expansion-final limit 937,120 fen 25 miao.
translations.idiomatic: Contraction-initial and expansion-final interval: 937,120 parts 25 seconds.

sentences.zh: 轉終二十七萬五千五百四十六分，半之爲轉中。

translations.literal: Rotation cycle 275,546 fen; halve it for rotation middle.
translations.idiomatic: Rotation cycle: 275,546 parts; halve it for rotation midpoint.

sentences.zh: 朔轉差一萬九千七百五十九分九十三秒。

translations.literal: New-moon rotation difference 19,759 fen 93 miao.
translations.idiomatic: New-moon rotation increment: 19,759 parts 93 seconds.

sentences.zh: 日轉限一十二限二十。

translations.literal: Day rotation limit twelve limits twenty.
translations.idiomatic: Daily rotation limit: 12 limits 20.

sentences.zh: 轉中限一百六十八限零八三零六零。

translations.literal: Rotation middle limit one hundred sixty-eight limits 083060.
translations.idiomatic: Rotation midpoint limit: 168 limits 083060.

sentences.zh: 以日轉限乘轉中。

translations.literal: Multiply rotation middle by day rotation limit.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the rotation midpoint by the daily rotation limit.

sentences.zh: 一名限總。

translations.literal: Also called limit total.
translations.idiomatic: Also called the limit aggregate.

sentences.zh: 朔轉限二十四限一零七一一四六。

translations.literal: New-moon rotation limit twenty-four limits 1071146.
translations.idiomatic: New-moon rotation limit: 24 limits 1071146.

sentences.zh: 以日轉限乘朔轉差。

translations.literal: Multiply new-moon rotation difference by day rotation limit.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the new-moon rotation increment by the daily rotation limit.

sentences.zh: 弦轉限九十零限零六八三零八六五。

translations.literal: Quarter-moon rotation limit ninety limits 06830865.
translations.idiomatic: Quarter-moon rotation limit: 90 limits 06830865.

sentences.zh: 以日轉限乘弦策。

translations.literal: Multiply quarter-moon divisor by day rotation limit.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the quarter-moon divisor by the daily rotation limit.

sentences.zh: 一名限策。

translations.literal: Also called limit divisor.
translations.idiomatic: Also called the limit divisor.

sentences.zh: 交終二十七萬二千一百二十二分二十四秒。

translations.literal: Crossing cycle 272,122 fen 24 miao.
translations.idiomatic: Nodal cycle: 272,122 parts 24 seconds.

sentences.zh: 朔交差二萬三千一百八十三分六十九秒。

translations.literal: New-moon crossing difference 23,183 fen 69 miao.
translations.idiomatic: New-moon node increment: 23,183 parts 69 seconds.

sentences.zh: 氣盈二千一百八十四分三十七秒五十微。

translations.literal: Qi expansion 2,184 fen 37 miao 50 wei.
translations.idiomatic: Qi expansion: 2,184 parts 37 seconds 50 micro-parts.

sentences.zh: 朔虛四千六百九十四分零七秒。

translations.literal: New-moon void 4,694 fen 07 miao.
translations.idiomatic: New-moon void: 4,694 parts 07 seconds.

sentences.zh: 沒限七千八百一十五分六十二秒五十微。

translations.literal: Submergence limit 7,815 fen 62 miao 50 wei.
translations.idiomatic: Submergence threshold: 7,815 parts 62 seconds 50 micro-parts.

sentences.zh: 盈策九萬六千六百九十五分二十八秒。

translations.literal: Expansion divisor 96,695 fen 28 miao.
translations.idiomatic: Expansion divisor: 96,695 parts 28 seconds.

sentences.zh: 虛策二萬九千一百零四分二十二秒。

translations.literal: Void divisor 29,104 fen 22 miao.
translations.idiomatic: Void divisor: 29,104 parts 22 seconds.

sentences.zh: 土王策三萬零四百三十六分八十七秒五十微。

translations.literal: Earth-king divisor 30,436 fen 87 miao 50 wei.
translations.idiomatic: Earth-king divisor: 30,436 parts 87 seconds 50 micro-parts.

sentences.zh: 宿策一萬五千三百零五分九十三秒。

translations.literal: Lodging divisor 15,305 fen 93 miao.
translations.idiomatic: Lodging divisor: 15,305 parts 93 seconds.

sentences.zh: 紀法六十萬。

translations.literal: Era divisor six hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Era divisor: 600,000.

sentences.zh: 即旬週六十日。

translations.literal: That is the ten-day circuit of sixty days.
translations.idiomatic: That is the sixty-day decad cycle.

sentences.zh: 推天正冬至 置距洪武甲子積年減一，以歲周乘之爲中積，加氣應爲通積，滿紀法去之，至不滿之數，爲天正冬至。

translations.literal: Step winter solstice of heaven's first month: set the interval from Hongwu jiazi accumulated years minus one; multiply by year circuit for middle accumulation; add qi response for universal accumulation; full era divisor remove it; to the number not full is winter solstice of heaven's first month.
translations.idiomatic: To find the winter solstice of the civil year: set the interval from the Hongwu jiazi epoch, subtract one, multiply by the tropical year length for the middle accumulation, add the qi offset for the universal accumulation, and divide by the era divisor; the remainder not reaching a full cycle is the winter solstice of the civil year.

sentences.zh: 以萬爲日，命甲子算外，爲冬至日辰。

translations.literal: Take ten thousand as day; name outside the jiazi count, for winter solstice day and double-hour.
translations.idiomatic: Take 10,000 as one day; count off from the jiazi origin to obtain the winter solstice date and double-hour.

sentences.zh: 累加通餘，即得次年天正冬至。

translations.literal: Accumulate adding universal remainder; then obtain next year's winter solstice of heaven's first month.
translations.idiomatic: Add the universal remainder repeatedly to obtain the next year's civil winter solstice.

sentences.zh: 推天正閏餘 置中積，加閏應，滿朔策去之，至不滿之數，爲天正閏餘。

translations.literal: Step heaven's first month intercalation remainder: set middle accumulation; add intercalation response; full new-moon divisor remove it; to the number not full is heaven's first month intercalation remainder.
translations.idiomatic: To find the civil-year intercalation remainder: set the middle accumulation, add the intercalation offset, divide by the synodic-month divisor, and take the remainder not reaching a full month as the civil intercalation remainder.

sentences.zh: 累加通閏，即得次年天正閏餘。

translations.literal: Accumulate adding universal intercalation; then obtain next year's heaven's first month intercalation remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Add the universal intercalation repeatedly to obtain the next year's civil intercalation remainder.

sentences.zh: 推天正經朔 置冬至，減閏餘，遇不及減，加紀法減之，爲天正經朔。

translations.literal: Step heaven's first month mean new moon: set winter solstice; subtract intercalation remainder; when subtraction cannot reach, add era divisor and subtract; this is heaven's first month mean new moon.
translations.idiomatic: To find the civil mean conjunction: set the winter solstice and subtract the intercalation remainder; if subtraction fails, add the era divisor and subtract again—this is the civil mean conjunction.

sentences.zh: 無閏加五十四萬三六七一一六。

translations.literal: Without intercalation add 543,671,116.
translations.idiomatic: In a common year, add 543,671,116.

sentences.zh: 十二朔策紀法。

translations.literal: Twelve new-moon divisors era divisor.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve synodic-month divisors equal the era divisor.

sentences.zh: 有閏，加二十三萬八九七七零九。

translations.literal: With intercalation, add 238,977,709.
translations.idiomatic: In an intercalary year, add 238,977,709.

sentences.zh: 十三朔實去紀法。

translations.literal: Thirteen new-moon constants remove era divisor.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteen synodic-month constants subtract the era divisor.

sentences.zh: 滿紀法仍去之，即得次年天正經朔 視天正閏餘在閏限已上，其年有閏月。

translations.literal: Full era divisor still remove it; then obtain next year's heaven's first month mean new moon. View heaven's first month intercalation remainder above intercalation limit— that year has intercalary month.
translations.idiomatic: When the era divisor is full, subtract it again to obtain the next year's civil mean conjunction. If the civil intercalation remainder lies above the intercalation threshold, that year has an intercalary month.

sentences.zh: 推天正盈縮 置半歲周，內減其年閏餘全分，餘爲所求天正縮歷。

translations.literal: Step heaven's first month expansion-contraction: set half year circuit; inward subtract that year's intercalation remainder in full fen; remainder is the sought heaven's first month contraction sequence.
translations.idiomatic: To find the civil-year solar equation at the winter solstice: set half the tropical year and subtract that year's full intercalation remainder; the remainder is the sought contraction sequence for the civil year.

sentences.zh: 如徑求次年者，於天正縮歷內減通閏，即得。

translations.literal: If directly seeking the next year, within heaven's first month contraction sequence subtract universal intercalation; then obtain.
translations.idiomatic: To proceed directly to the next year, subtract the universal intercalation from the civil contraction sequence.

sentences.zh: 減後，視在一百五十三日零九已下者，復加朔實，爲次年天正縮歷。

translations.literal: After subtraction, if viewing below 153 days 09, again add new-moon constant for next year's heaven's first month contraction sequence.
translations.idiomatic: After subtraction, if the value falls below 153 days 09, add the synodic-month constant again for the next year's civil contraction sequence.

sentences.zh: 推天正遲疾 置中積，加轉應，減去其年閏餘全分，餘滿轉終去之，即天正入轉。

translations.literal: Step heaven's first month slow-rapid: set middle accumulation; add rotation response; subtract that year's intercalation remainder in full fen; remainder full rotation cycle remove it; that is heaven's first month entry into rotation.
translations.idiomatic: To find the civil lunar anomaly: set the middle accumulation, add the rotation offset, subtract that year's full intercalation remainder, and divide the remainder by the rotation cycle—this is the civil entry into rotation.

sentences.zh: 視在轉中已下爲疾歷，已上去之爲遲歷。

translations.literal: View below rotation middle as rapid sequence; above, remove it for slow sequence.
translations.idiomatic: If below the rotation midpoint, it is the rapid sequence; if above, subtract the midpoint for the slow sequence.

sentences.zh: 如徑求次年者，加二十三萬七一一九一六，十二轉差之積。

translations.literal: If directly seeking next year, add 237,191,916—the accumulated twelve rotation differences.
translations.idiomatic: To proceed directly to the next year, add 237,191,916—the accumulated twelve rotation increments.

sentences.zh: 經閏再加轉差，皆滿轉終去之，遲疾各仍其舊。

translations.literal: Passing intercalation again add rotation difference; all full rotation cycle remove it; slow and rapid each remain as before.
translations.idiomatic: In an intercalary year add the rotation increment again; divide by the rotation cycle whenever full; slow and rapid each retain their prior state.

sentences.zh: 若滿轉中去之，爲遲疾相代。

translations.literal: If full rotation cycle remove it, slow and rapid alternate in succession.
translations.idiomatic: When the rotation cycle is full, subtract it and slow and rapid alternate in turn.

sentences.zh: 推天正入交 置中積，減閏餘，加交應，滿交終去之，即天正入交凡日。

translations.literal: Step heaven's first month entry into crossing: set middle accumulation; subtract intercalation remainder; add crossing response; full crossing cycle remove it; that is heaven's first month entry into crossing, all days.
translations.idiomatic: To find the civil nodal entry: set the middle accumulation, subtract the intercalation remainder, add the node offset, and divide by the nodal cycle—this is the civil nodal entry in days.

sentences.zh: 如徑求次年者，加六千零八十二分零四秒，十二交差內去交終。

translations.literal: If directly seeking next year, add 6,082 fen 04 miao—twelve crossing differences inward remove crossing cycle.
translations.idiomatic: To proceed directly to the next year, add 6,082 parts 04 seconds—the twelve node increments, subtracting the nodal cycle within.

sentences.zh: 經閏加二萬九千二百六十五分七十三秒，十三交差內去交終。

translations.literal: Passing intercalation add 29,265 fen 73 miao—thirteen crossing differences inward remove crossing cycle.
translations.idiomatic: In an intercalary year add 29,265 parts 73 seconds—the thirteen node increments, subtracting the nodal cycle within.

sentences.zh: 皆滿交終仍去之，即得。

translations.literal: All full crossing cycle still remove it; then obtain.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the nodal cycle is full, subtract it again to obtain the result.

sentences.zh: 推各月經朔及弦望 置天正經朔策，滿紀法去之，即得正月經朔。

translations.literal: Step each month's mean new moon and quarter-full moons: set heaven's first month mean new moon divisor; full era divisor remove it; then obtain first month mean new moon.
translations.idiomatic: To find each month's mean conjunction and quarter- and full moons: set the civil mean conjunction divisor; divide by the era divisor; the remainder is the first month's mean conjunction.

sentences.zh: 以弦策累加之，去紀法，即得弦望及次朔。

translations.literal: Accumulate adding quarter-moon divisor; remove era divisor; then obtain quarter-full moons and next new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Add the quarter-moon divisor repeatedly and subtract the era divisor to obtain the quarter- and full moons and successive conjunctions.

sentences.zh: 推各恆氣 置天正冬至，加三氣策，滿紀法去之，即得立春恆日。

translations.literal: Step each constant qi: set heaven's first month winter solstice; add three qi divisors; full era divisor remove it; then obtain Beginning of Spring constant day.
translations.idiomatic: To find each mean solar term: set the civil winter solstice, add three qi divisors, divide by the era divisor, and obtain the constant day of Beginning of Spring.

sentences.zh: 以氣策累加之，去紀法，即得二十四氣恆日。

translations.literal: Accumulate adding qi divisor; remove era divisor; then obtain the twenty-four qi constant days.
translations.idiomatic: Add the qi divisor repeatedly and subtract the era divisor to obtain the constant days of all twenty-four terms.

sentences.zh: 推閏在何月 置朔策，以有閏之年之閏餘減之，餘爲實，以月閏爲法而一，得數命起天正次月算外，即得所閏之月。

translations.literal: Step in which month the intercalation falls: set new-moon divisor; subtract that intercalary year's intercalation remainder; remainder is dividend; take month intercalation as divisor and unify; obtain number—name starting heaven's first month next month outside count; then obtain the intercalated month.
translations.idiomatic: To find which month receives the intercalation: set the synodic-month divisor and subtract that intercalary year's intercalation remainder; take the remainder as dividend and the monthly intercalation unit as divisor; the quotient, counted from the month after the civil new year, names the intercalary month.

sentences.zh: 閏有進退，仍以定朔無中氣爲定。

translations.literal: Intercalation has advance and retreat; still fix by true new moon lacking mid-qi.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalation may advance or retreat; the true conjunction lacking a mid-term qi remains the final criterion.

sentences.zh: 如減餘不及月閏，或僅及一月閏者，爲閏在年前。

translations.literal: If subtracting remainder cannot reach month intercalation, or only reaches one month intercalation, intercalation is before the year.
translations.idiomatic: If the remainder after subtraction falls short of one monthly intercalation unit, or only reaches one such unit, the intercalation belongs to the preceding year.

sentences.zh: 推各月盈縮歷 置天正縮歷，加二朔策，去半歲周，即得正月經朔下盈歷。

translations.literal: Step each month's expansion-contraction sequence: set heaven's first month contraction sequence; add two new-moon divisors; remove half year circuit; then obtain first month mean new moon below expansion sequence.
translations.idiomatic: To find each month's solar equation sequence: set the civil contraction sequence, add two synodic-month divisors, and subtract half the tropical year to obtain the expansion sequence below the first month's mean conjunction.

sentences.zh: 累加弦策，各得弦望及次朔，如滿半歲周去之交縮，滿半周又去之即復交盈。

translations.literal: Accumulate adding quarter-moon divisor; each obtain quarter-full moons and next new moon; if full half year circuit remove it for crossing contraction; full half circuit again remove it then again crossing expansion.
translations.idiomatic: Add the quarter-moon divisor repeatedly for each quarter- and full moon and successive conjunction; when half the tropical year is full, subtract it for nodal contraction; when half a cycle is full again, subtract once more to return to nodal expansion.

sentences.zh: 推初末限 視盈歷在盈初縮末限已下，縮歷在縮初盈末限已下，各爲初。

translations.literal: Step initial and final limits: view expansion sequence below expansion-initial contraction-final limit, contraction sequence below contraction-initial expansion-final limit—each is initial.
translations.idiomatic: To find the initial and final limits: if the expansion sequence lies below the expansion-initial and contraction-final interval, or the contraction sequence below the contraction-initial and expansion-final interval, each is initial.

sentences.zh: 已上用減半歲周爲末。

translations.literal: Above, use subtracting half year circuit for final.
translations.idiomatic: Above those thresholds, subtract half the tropical year for the final interval.

sentences.zh: 推盈縮差 置初末歷小余，以立成內所有盈縮加之乘之爲實，日週一萬爲法除之，得婁數以加其下盈縮積，即盈縮差。

translations.literal: Step expansion-contraction difference: set initial-final sequence small remainder; from ready reckoners within add expansion-contraction and multiply for dividend; day circuit ten thousand as divisor divide it; obtain lou number to add below expansion-contraction accumulation; that is expansion-contraction difference.
translations.idiomatic: To find the solar equation correction: set the small remainder of the initial or final interval, add the expansion–contraction entry from the ready reckoners and multiply for the dividend; divide by the day unit of 10,000; add the resulting lou number to the underlying equation accumulation to obtain the equation correction.

sentences.zh: 推各月遲疾歷 置天正經朔遲疾歷，加二轉差，得正月經朔下遲疾歷。

translations.literal: Step each month's slow-rapid sequence: set heaven's first month mean new moon slow-rapid sequence; add two rotation differences; obtain first month mean new moon below slow-rapid sequence.
translations.idiomatic: To find each month's lunar anomaly sequence: set the civil mean-conjunction anomaly sequence and add two rotation increments to obtain the anomaly sequence below the first month's mean conjunction.

sentences.zh: 累加弦策，得弦望及次朔，皆滿轉中去之，爲遲疾相代。

translations.literal: Accumulate adding quarter-moon divisor; obtain quarter-full moons and next new moon; all full rotation cycle remove it; slow and rapid alternate in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Add the quarter-moon divisor repeatedly for quarter- and full moons and successive conjunctions; whenever the rotation cycle is full, subtract it and slow and rapid alternate in turn.

sentences.zh: 推遲疾限 各置遲次歷，以日轉限乘之，即得限數。

translations.literal: Step slow-rapid limits: each set slow sequence count; multiply by day rotation limit; then obtain limit number.
translations.idiomatic: To find the anomaly limits: for each slow-interval count, multiply by the daily rotation limit to obtain the limit number.

sentences.zh: 以弦轉限累加之，滿轉中限去之，即各弦望及次朔限。

translations.literal: Accumulate adding quarter-moon rotation limit; full rotation middle limit remove it; then each quarter-full moon and next new moon limit.
translations.idiomatic: Add the quarter-moon rotation limit repeatedly; when the rotation midpoint limit is full, subtract it to obtain the limit for each quarter- and full moon and successive conjunction.

sentences.zh: 如徑求次月，以朔轉限加之，亦滿轉中去之，即得。

translations.literal: To seek the next month directly, add the new-moon revolution limit; when full, remove within the revolution midpoint—then it is obtained.
translations.idiomatic: To find the next month directly, add the new-moon revolution limit; when it fills the revolution midpoint, discard the excess to obtain the result.

sentences.zh: 又法：視立成中日率，有與遲疾歷較小布相近者以減之，餘在八百二十已下，即所用限。

translations.literal: Another method: inspect the day-rate in the ready reckoners; where one is close to the small cloth of the slow-rapid ephemeris, subtract it; if the remainder is 820 or below, that is the limit to use.
translations.idiomatic: Alternate method: take the day-rate from the ready reckoners; where it is close to the small cloth value in the slow-rapid ephemeris, subtract it; a remainder of 820 or less gives the applicable limit.

sentences.zh: 求遲疾差 置遲疾歷，以立成日率減之，如不及減，則退一位。

translations.literal: To seek the slow-rapid difference: set the slow-rapid ephemeris and subtract the ready-reckoner day-rate; if it cannot be subtracted, retreat one place.
translations.idiomatic: To find the slow-rapid difference: set the slow-rapid ephemeris and subtract the ready-reckoner day-rate; if subtraction is impossible, shift back one decimal place.

sentences.zh: 餘以其下損益分乘之爲實，八百二十分爲法除之，得數以加其下遲疾積，即遲疾差。

translations.literal: With the remainder, multiply by the increase-decrease parts below as dividend; with 820 parts as divisor, divide to get the number and add to the slow-rapid accumulation below—that is the slow-rapid difference.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the remainder by the increase-decrease increment below as dividend; divide by 820 parts as divisor; add the quotient to the underlying slow-rapid accumulation to obtain the slow-rapid difference.

sentences.zh: 推加減差 視經朔弦望下所得盈縮差、遲疾差，以盈遇遲、縮遇疾爲同相併，盈遇疾、縮遇遲爲異相較，各以八百二十分乘之爲實，再以遲疾限行度內減去八百於二十分，爲定限度爲法，法除實爲加減差。

translations.literal: To seek the additive-subtractive difference: inspect the expansion-contraction difference and slow-rapid difference obtained below each mean new moon, first quarter, full moon, and last quarter; surplus meeting slow and deficit meeting rapid are alike and combined; surplus meeting rapid and deficit meeting slow are unlike and compared; each multiply by 820 parts as dividend; again within the slow-rapid limit's travel degrees subtract 820 parts as the fixed limit for divisor; divide the dividend by the divisor for the additive-subtractive difference.
translations.idiomatic: To find the additive-subtractive difference: take the expansion-contraction and slow-rapid differences below each mean new moon, first quarter, full moon, and last quarter; combine like cases (surplus with slow, deficit with rapid) and compare unlike cases (surplus with rapid, deficit with slow); multiply each by 820 parts as dividend; subtract 820 from the degrees within the slow-rapid limit to form the fixed-limit divisor; divide to obtain the additive-subtractive difference.

sentences.zh: 盈遲爲加，縮疾爲減，異名相較者，盈多疾爲加，疾多於盈爲減，縮多於遲減，遲多於縮加。

translations.literal: Surplus with slow is add, deficit with rapid is subtract; where names differ and are compared, if surplus exceeds slow it is add; if rapid exceeds surplus it is subtract; if deficit exceeds slow it is subtract; if slow exceeds deficit it is add.
translations.idiomatic: Surplus paired with slow yields addition; deficit paired with rapid yields subtraction. In cross-comparison: if surplus exceeds slow, add; if rapid exceeds surplus, subtract; if deficit exceeds slow, subtract; if slow exceeds deficit, add.

sentences.zh: 推定朔望 各置經朔弦望，以加減差加減之，即爲定日。

translations.literal: To seek the fixed new and full moons: set each mean new moon, first quarter, full moon, and last quarter and add or subtract the additive-subtractive difference—that is the fixed day.
translations.idiomatic: To find the true new and full moons: set each mean new moon, first quarter, full moon, and last quarter, then add or subtract the additive-subtractive difference to obtain the true date.

sentences.zh: 視定朔幹名，與後朔同者月大，不同者月小，內無中氣者爲閏月。

translations.literal: Inspect the sexagenary day of the fixed new moon: if it matches the following new moon the month is long; if different, short; if no mean qi falls within, it is an intercalary month.
translations.idiomatic: Check the sexagenary day of the true new moon: if it matches the next new moon the month is long; if not, short; if no mean qi falls within the month, it is intercalary.

sentences.zh: 其弦望在立成相同日日出分已下者，則退一日命之。

translations.literal: If first quarter or full moon falls on the same day in the ready reckoners with sunrise parts already passed, retreat one day in naming it.
translations.idiomatic: If a quarter or full moon shares the same ready-reckoner day but sunrise parts have already elapsed, name it one day earlier.

sentences.zh: 推各月入交 置天正經朔入交凡日加二交差，得正月經朔下入交凡日。

translations.literal: To seek each month's entry into conjunction: set the mean new moon's entry into conjunction at heaven's first month; add twice the nodal difference to obtain the mean new moon's entry into conjunction for the first civil month.
translations.idiomatic: To find each month's nodal entry: set the mean new moon's nodal entry at the celestial first month; add twice the nodal difference to obtain the first civil month's mean new moon nodal entry.

sentences.zh: 累加交望，滿交終去之，即得各月下入交凡日。

translations.literal: Accumulate by adding the nodal quarter intervals; when full remove the nodal cycle—then obtain each month's entry into conjunction below.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulate nodal quarter intervals; when full, discard the nodal cycle to obtain each month's nodal entry.

sentences.zh: 徑求次月，加交差即得。

translations.literal: To seek the next month directly, add the nodal difference and it is obtained.
translations.idiomatic: To find the next month directly, add the nodal difference.

sentences.zh: 推土王用事 置穀雨、大暑、霜降、大寒恆氣日，減土王策，如不及減，加紀法減之，即各得土王用事日。

translations.literal: To seek the Earth-king dominion: set the mean-qi days of Grain Rain, Great Heat, Frost's Descent, and Great Cold; subtract the Earth-king parameter; if subtraction fails, add the era cycle and subtract to obtain each Earth-king dominion day.
translations.idiomatic: To find the Earth-king dominion: set the mean-qi days of Grain Rain, Great Heat, Frost's Descent, and Great Cold; subtract the Earth-king parameter; if insufficient, add the era cycle and subtract again to obtain each dominion day.

sentences.zh: 推發斂加時 各置所推定朔弦望及恆氣之小余，以十二乘之，滿萬爲時，命起子正。

translations.literal: To seek emission-contraction with time-of-day: for each fixed new moon, first quarter, full moon, last quarter, and mean qi, set the lesser remainder and multiply by twelve; when full divide by 10,000 for the double-hour, counting from midnight of zi.
translations.idiomatic: To find emission-contraction with time-of-day: for each true new moon, quarter, full moon, and mean qi, take the lesser remainder, multiply by twelve, and divide by 10,000 for the double-hour, counting from zi midnight.

sentences.zh: 滿五千，又進一時，命起子初。

translations.literal: When it reaches 5,000, advance one more double-hour, counting from the first quarter of zi.
translations.idiomatic: At 5,000 parts, advance one further double-hour, counting from the first quarter of zi.

sentences.zh: 算外得時不滿者，以一千二百除之爲刻，命起初刻。

translations.literal: Beyond the count obtain the double-hour; what does not fill a double-hour, divide by 1,200 for quarter-hours, counting from the first quarter-hour.
translations.idiomatic: After the double-hour is fixed, divide the remainder by 1,200 for quarter-hours, counting from the first quarter-hour.

sentences.zh: 初正時之刻，皆以初一二三四爲好，於算外命之。

translations.literal: For the first quarter-hour of the midnight double-hour, all use first, second, third, and fourth as auspicious, naming beyond the count.
translations.idiomatic: For the first quarter-hour at midnight, only the first through fourth quarter-hours are used in naming; the remainder is named beyond the count.

sentences.zh: 其第四刻爲畸零，得刻法三之一，凡三時成一刻，以足十二時百刻之數。

translations.literal: The fourth quarter-hour is fractional; it takes one-third of a quarter-hour unit; in all three double-hours make one quarter-hour, to complete the twelve double-hours and one hundred quarter-hours.
translations.idiomatic: The fourth quarter-hour is fractional, taking one-third of a quarter-hour unit; three such double-hours complete one quarter-hour, filling out twelve double-hours and one hundred quarter-hours.

sentences.zh: 按古因及《授時》，皆以發斂爲一章。

translations.literal: According to antiquity and the Season Granting Calendar, emission-contraction forms one chapter.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity and in the Season Granting Calendar, emission-contraction formed its own chapter.

sentences.zh: 發斂去者，日道發南斂北之細數也，而加時附焉，則又所以紀發斂之辰刻，故曰發斂加時也。

translations.literal: What emission-contraction removes is the fine numbers of the sun's path opening south and closing north; attaching time-of-day to it then also records the double-hours and quarter-hours of emission-contraction—hence it is called emission-contraction with time-of-day.
translations.idiomatic: Emission-contraction records the fine gradations of the sun's path opening southward and closing northward; attaching time-of-day further fixes the double-hours and quarter-hours of that process—hence emission-contraction with time-of-day.

sentences.zh: 《大統》取其便算，故合發斂與氣朔共爲一章，或以乘除疏發斂，非其質矣。

translations.literal: The Grand Concordance took convenience in calculation, so combined emission-contraction with qi and new moon in one chapter, or used multiplication-division to thin emission-contraction—not its true substance.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Concordance favored ease of calculation and merged emission-contraction with qi and new moon into one chapter, or thinned emission-contraction through multiplication and division—neither preserves its true substance.

sentences.zh: 推盈日 視恆氣小余，在沒限已上，爲有盈之氣。

translations.literal: To seek surplus days: inspect the mean qi's lesser remainder; if above the extinction limit, it is a qi with surplus.
translations.idiomatic: To find surplus days: inspect the mean qi's lesser remainder; if it lies above the extinction limit, that qi has surplus.

sentences.zh: 置策餘一萬零一四五六二五，以十五日除氣策。

translations.literal: Set the parameter remainder 10,014,562.5 and divide the qi parameter by fifteen days.
translations.idiomatic: Set the parameter remainder at 10,014,562.5 and divide the qi parameter by fifteen days.

sentences.zh: 以有盈之氣小余減之，餘以六十八分六六以氣盈除十五日。

translations.literal: Subtract from it the lesser remainder of the qi with surplus; with the remainder, by 68 parts 66 divide the qi surplus into fifteen days.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the surplus qi's lesser remainder; with the remainder, apportion the qi surplus over fifteen days at 68 parts 66.

sentences.zh: 乘之，得數以加恆氣大餘，滿紀法去之，命甲子算外，得盈日。

translations.literal: Multiply to get the number and add to the mean qi's greater remainder; when full remove the era cycle; count from jiazi beyond the count to obtain the surplus day.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply to obtain a value, add it to the mean qi's greater remainder, discard the era cycle when full, and count from jiazi beyond the count for the surplus day.

sentences.zh: 求盈日及分秒，以盈策加之，又去紀法，即得。

translations.literal: To seek the surplus day and its parts and seconds, add the surplus parameter and again remove the era cycle—that is obtained.
translations.idiomatic: To find the surplus day with parts and seconds, add the surplus parameter and again discard the era cycle.

sentences.zh: 推虛日 視經朔小余在朔虛已下，爲有虛之朔。

translations.literal: To seek void days: inspect the mean new moon's lesser remainder; if below the new-moon void, it is a new moon with void.
translations.idiomatic: To find void days: inspect the mean new moon's lesser remainder; if below the new-moon void limit, that new moon carries void.

sentences.zh: 置有虛之朔小余，以六十三分九一以朔虛除三十日。

translations.literal: Set the void new moon's lesser remainder; by 63 parts 91 divide the new-moon void into thirty days.
translations.idiomatic: Set the void new moon's lesser remainder; apportion the new-moon void over thirty days at 63 parts 91.

sentences.zh: 乘之，得數以加經朔大餘，滿紀法去之，命甲子算外爲虛日。

translations.literal: Multiply to get the number and add to the mean new moon's greater remainder; when full remove the era cycle; count from jiazi beyond the count for the void day.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply to obtain a value, add it to the mean new moon's greater remainder, discard the era cycle when full, and count from jiazi beyond the count for the void day.

sentences.zh: 求次虛。

translations.literal: To seek the next void.
translations.idiomatic: To find the next void day.

sentences.zh: 置日及分秒，以虛策加之，又去紀法，即得。

translations.literal: Set the day and its parts and seconds; add the void parameter and again remove the era cycle—that is obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Set the day with parts and seconds; add the void parameter and again discard the era cycle.

sentences.zh: 推直宿 置通積，以氣應加中積。

translations.literal: To seek the lodge directly below: set the general accumulation and add the qi correspondence to the central accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: To find the lodge directly below: set the general accumulation and add the qi correspondence to the central accumulation.

sentences.zh: 減閏應，以宿會二十八萬累去之，餘命起翼宿算外，得天正經朔直宿。

translations.literal: Subtract the intercalation correspondence; remove repeatedly by the lodge conjunction 280,000; with the remainder count from Wings beyond the count to obtain the mean new moon's lodge at heaven's first month.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the intercalation correspondence; repeatedly remove the lodge conjunction of 280,000; with the remainder count from Wings beyond the count for the celestial first month's mean new moon lodge.

sentences.zh: 置天正經宿直宿，加兩宿策，爲正月經朔直宿。

translations.literal: Set the celestial first month's lodge directly below; add two lodge parameters for the first civil month's mean new moon lodge.
translations.idiomatic: Set the celestial first month's lodge; add two lodge parameters for the first civil month's mean new moon lodge.

sentences.zh: 以宿策累加，得各月經朔直宿。

translations.literal: Accumulate by adding the lodge parameter to obtain each month's mean new moon lodge.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulate by adding the lodge parameter to obtain each month's mean new moon lodge.

sentences.zh: 再以各月朔下加減差加減之，爲定朔直宿。

translations.literal: Again add or subtract each month's new-moon additive-subtractive difference to obtain the fixed new moon's lodge.
translations.idiomatic: Then add or subtract each month's new-moon additive-subtractive difference to obtain the true new moon's lodge.

sentences.zh: ▲步日躔

translations.literal: ▲ Step the sun's path.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Solar motion.

sentences.zh: 周天三百六十五度二十五分七十五秒，半之爲半周天，又半之爲象限。

translations.literal: Circumference of heaven 365 degrees 25 parts 75 seconds; halved is half the circumference of heaven; halved again is the quadrant limit.
translations.idiomatic: The celestial circuit is 365°25′75″; half is half the celestial circuit; half again is the quadrant limit.

sentences.zh: 歲差一分五十秒。

translations.literal: Precession one part fifty seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Precession: 1′50″ per year.

sentences.zh: 周應三百一十五度一十分七十五秒。

translations.literal: Circuit correspondence 315 degrees 10 parts 75 seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit correspondence: 315°10′75″.

sentences.zh: 按此係至元辛巳之周應，乃自虛七度至箕十之度數也。

translations.literal: According to this it is the circuit correspondence of xinsi in the Zhiyuan era—it is the degrees from Void 7° to Winnowing Basket 10°.
translations.idiomatic: This is the Zhiyuan xinsi circuit correspondence—the arc from Void 7° to Winnowing Basket 10°.

sentences.zh: 洪武甲子相距一百四年，歲差已退天五十四分五十秒，而周應仍用舊數，殆傳習之誤耳。

translations.literal: From Hongwu jiazi the distance is one hundred four years; precession has already retreated fifty-four parts fifty seconds against heaven, yet the circuit correspondence still uses the old numbers—probably an error of transmission.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu jiazi lies one hundred four years later; precession has already shifted heaven by 54′50″, yet the circuit correspondence still uses the old value—likely a transmission error.

sentences.zh: 推天正冬至日躔赤道宿次 置中積，加周應，應減距曆元甲子以來歲差。

translations.literal: To seek the celestial winter solstice's solar motion in equatorial lodge positions: set the central accumulation, add the circuit correspondence, and subtract precession since the distance-calendar origin jiazi.
translations.idiomatic: To find the winter solstice's solar position in equatorial lodges: set the central accumulation, add the circuit correspondence, and subtract precession accumulated since the epoch jiazi.

sentences.zh: 滿周天去之，不盡，起虛七度，依各宿次去之，即冬至加時赤道日度。

translations.literal: When full remove the celestial circuit; what remains, start from Void 7° and remove by each lodge in turn—that is the equatorial solar degree at winter solstice with time-of-day.
translations.idiomatic: Discard full celestial circuits; with the remainder start at Void 7° and subtract each lodge in turn to obtain the equatorial solar degree at winter solstice with time-of-day.

sentences.zh: 如求次年，累減歲差，即得。

translations.literal: To seek the next year, accumulate by subtracting precession—that is obtained.
translations.idiomatic: For the following year, subtract precession cumulatively.

translations.idiomatic: [Table omitted.]

sentences.zh: 推天正冬至日躔黃道宿次 置冬至加時赤道日度，以至後赤道積度減之，餘以黃道率乘之。

translations.literal: To seek the celestial winter solstice's solar motion in ecliptic lodge positions: set the equatorial solar degree at winter solstice with time-of-day; subtract the equatorial accumulated degrees after the solstice; with the remainder multiply by the ecliptic rate.
translations.idiomatic: To find the winter solstice solar position in ecliptic lodges: set the equatorial solar degree at winter solstice with time-of-day, subtract the post-solstice equatorial accumulation, and multiply the remainder by the ecliptic rate.

sentences.zh: 如赤道率而一，得數以加黃道積度，即冬至加時黃道日度。

translations.literal: Divide as the equatorial rate to one, get the number and add to the ecliptic accumulated degrees—that is the ecliptic solar degree at winter solstice with time-of-day.
translations.idiomatic: Divide by the equatorial rate, add the quotient to the ecliptic accumulation, and obtain the ecliptic solar degree at winter solstice with time-of-day.

sentences.zh: 黃赤道積度及度率，俱見《法原》。

translations.literal: Ecliptic and equatorial accumulated degrees and degree-rates are all in Origins of the Method.
translations.idiomatic: Ecliptic and equatorial accumulations and degree-rates all appear in Origins of the Method.
