translations.idiomatic: [Table omitted.]

sentences.zh: 推定象限度 以冬至加時赤道日度，與冬至加時黃道日度相減，爲黃赤道差。

translations.literal: To seek the fixed quadrant limit: subtract the ecliptic solar degree at winter solstice with time-of-day from the equatorial—that is the ecliptic-equatorial difference.
translations.idiomatic: To find the fixed quadrant limit: subtract the ecliptic winter-solstice solar degree from the equatorial to obtain the ecliptic-equatorial difference.

sentences.zh: 以本年黃赤道差，與次年黃赤道相減，餘以四而一，加入氣象限內，爲定象限度。

translations.literal: Subtract the next year's ecliptic-equatorial difference from this year's; divide the remainder by four and add within the qi image limit to obtain the fixed quadrant limit.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the following year's ecliptic-equatorial difference from this year's; divide the remainder by four and add it within the qi image limit to obtain the fixed quadrant limit.

sentences.zh: 推四正定氣日 置所推冬至分，即爲冬正定氣，加盈初縮末限，滿紀法去之，餘爲人正定氣。

translations.literal: To seek the four fixed qi days: set the winter solstice parts sought—that is the winter fixed qi; add the expansion-initial and contraction-final limit; when full remove the era cycle; the remainder is the ren fixed qi.
translations.idiomatic: To find the four fixed qi days: set the computed winter solstice parts as the winter fixed qi; add the expansion-initial and contraction-final limit; discard the era cycle when full; the remainder is the spring fixed qi.

sentences.zh: 加縮初盈末限，去紀法，餘爲秋正定氣。

translations.literal: Add the contraction-initial and expansion-final limit and remove the era cycle; the remainder is the autumnal fixed qi.
translations.idiomatic: Add the contraction-initial and expansion-final limit, discard the era cycle, and obtain the autumnal fixed qi.

sentences.zh: 加縮初盈末限，去紀法，餘爲次年冬正定氣。

translations.literal: Add the contraction-initial and expansion-final limit and remove the era cycle; the remainder is the next year's winter fixed qi.
translations.idiomatic: Add the contraction-initial and expansion-final limit again, discard the era cycle, and obtain the next year's winter fixed qi.

sentences.zh: 推四正相距日 以前正定氣大餘，減次正定氣大餘，加六十日，得相距日。

translations.literal: To seek the four fixed intervals in days: subtract the next fixed qi's greater remainder from the previous fixed qi's greater remainder and add sixty days to obtain the interval in days.
translations.idiomatic: To find the four fixed intervals in days: subtract the next fixed qi's greater remainder from the previous and add sixty days.

sentences.zh: 如次正氣不及減者，加六十日減之，再加六十日，爲相距日。

translations.literal: If the next fixed qi cannot be subtracted from, add sixty days and subtract; add sixty days again for the interval in days.
translations.idiomatic: If the next fixed qi is smaller, add sixty days before subtracting; add sixty days again for the interval.

sentences.zh: 推四正加時黃道積度 置冬至加時黃道日度，累加定象限，各得四正加時黃道積度。

translations.literal: To seek the four fixed times-of-day ecliptic accumulated degrees: set the ecliptic solar degree at winter solstice with time-of-day; accumulate by adding the fixed quadrant limit to obtain each fixed time's ecliptic accumulated degree.
translations.idiomatic: To find the four fixed ecliptic accumulations at time-of-day: set the winter solstice ecliptic solar degree and add the fixed quadrant limit cumulatively for each fixed time.

sentences.zh: 推四正加時減分 置四正定氣小余，以其初日行度乘之，如日周而一，爲各正加時減分。

translations.literal: To seek the four fixed times-of-day reduction parts: set each fixed qi's lesser remainder; multiply by its first-day travel degree; divide by the solar circuit to one for each fixed time's reduction at time-of-day.
translations.idiomatic: To find the four fixed reduction parts at time-of-day: take each fixed qi's lesser remainder, multiply by its first-day travel degree, and divide by the solar circuit.

sentences.zh: 冬正行一度零五一零八五。

translations.literal: Winter fixed travels one degree 0 parts 51085.
translations.idiomatic: The winter fixed qi travels 1°0.51085 per day.

sentences.zh: 春正距夏正九十三日者，行零度九九九七零三，距九十四日者行一度。

translations.literal: Spring fixed at ninety-three days from summer fixed travels 0 degrees 999703; at ninety-four days travels one degree.
translations.idiomatic: From the spring fixed qi, at ninety-three days to the summer fixed qi the travel is 0°0.999703 per day; at ninety-four days, 1° per day.

sentences.zh: 夏正行零度九五一五一六。

translations.literal: Summer fixed travels 0 degrees 951516.
translations.idiomatic: The summer fixed qi travels 0°0.951516 per day.

sentences.zh: 秋正距冬正八十八日者，行一度零零零五零五，距八十九日者行一度。

translations.literal: Autumn fixed at eighty-eight days from winter fixed travels one degree 000505; at eighty-nine days travels one degree.
translations.idiomatic: From the autumn fixed qi, at eighty-eight days to the winter fixed qi the travel is 1°0.000505 per day; at eighty-nine days, 1° per day.

sentences.zh: 推四正夜半積度 置四正加時黃道積芭，減去其加時減分，即得。

translations.literal: To seek the four fixed midnight accumulated degrees: set each fixed time's ecliptic accumulated degree and subtract its time-of-day reduction part—that is obtained.
translations.idiomatic: To find the four fixed midnight ecliptic accumulations: set each fixed time's ecliptic accumulation and subtract its time-of-day reduction.

sentences.zh: 推四正夜半黃道宿次 置四正夜半黃道積度，滿黃道宿度去之，即得。

translations.literal: To seek the four fixed midnight ecliptic lodge positions: set each fixed midnight ecliptic accumulated degree; when full remove ecliptic lodge degrees—that is obtained.
translations.idiomatic: To find the four fixed midnight ecliptic lodges: set each midnight ecliptic accumulation and discard full ecliptic lodge degrees.

sentences.zh: 推四正夜半相距度 置次正夜半黃道積度，以前正夜半黃道積度減之，餘爲兩正相距度，遇不及減者，加周天減之。

translations.literal: To seek the four fixed midnight interval degrees: set the next fixed midnight ecliptic accumulation; subtract the previous fixed midnight ecliptic accumulation; the remainder is the interval between the two fixed times; if subtraction fails, add the celestial circuit and subtract.
translations.idiomatic: To find the four fixed midnight interval degrees: subtract the previous midnight ecliptic accumulation from the next; if insufficient, add the celestial circuit before subtracting.

sentences.zh: 推四正行度加減日差 雙相距度與相距日下行積度相減，餘如相距日而一，爲日差。

translations.literal: To seek the four fixed travel-degree day-differences: subtract the travel accumulation below the interval in days from the doubled interval degree; divide the remainder by the interval in days to one for the day-difference.
translations.idiomatic: To find the four fixed travel day-differences: subtract the travel accumulation below the interval from twice the interval degree; divide the remainder by the interval in days for the day-difference.

sentences.zh: 從相距度人減去行積度者爲加，從積度內減去相距度者爲減。

translations.literal: Where the travel accumulation is subtracted from within the interval degree, that is add; where the interval degree is subtracted from within the travel accumulation, that is subtract.
translations.idiomatic: If the travel accumulation is subtracted from within the interval degree, the day-difference is additive; if the interval degree is subtracted from within the travel accumulation, it is subtractive.

sentences.zh: 秋正距冬至，冬至距春正八十八日，行積度九十度四零零九，八十九日行積度九十一度四零一四。

translations.literal: Autumn fixed from winter solstice, winter solstice from spring fixed at eighty-eight days, travel accumulation ninety degrees 4009; at eighty-nine days travel accumulation ninety-one degrees 4014.
translations.idiomatic: From the autumn fixed qi to the winter solstice, and from the winter solstice to the spring fixed qi: at eighty-eight days the travel accumulation is 90°4009; at eighty-nine days, 91°4014.

sentences.zh: 春正距夏至，夏至距秋秋正九十三日，行積度九十度五九九零，九十四日行積十五九八七。

translations.literal: Spring fixed from summer solstice, summer solstice from autumn autumn fixed at ninety-three days, travel accumulation ninety degrees 5990; at ninety-four days travel accumulation fifteen 15987.
translations.idiomatic: From the spring fixed qi to the summer solstice, and from the summer solstice to the autumn fixed qi: at ninety-three days the travel accumulation is 90°5990; at ninety-four days, 91°5987.

sentences.zh: 推每日夜度 置四正後每日行度，在立成。

translations.literal: To seek each day's nightly degree: set the daily travel after each fixed time in the ready reckoners.
translations.idiomatic: To find each day's midnight solar degree: set the daily travel after each fixed time from the ready reckoners.

sentences.zh: 以日差加減之，爲每日行定度。

translations.literal: Add or subtract the day-difference for the fixed travel degree.
translations.idiomatic: Add or subtract the day-difference to obtain the fixed daily travel.

sentences.zh: 置四正夜半日度，以行定度每日加之，滿黃道宿度去之，即每日夜半日度。

translations.literal: Set the four fixed midnight solar degrees; add the fixed travel daily; when full remove ecliptic lodge degrees—that is each day's midnight solar degree.
translations.idiomatic: Set the four fixed midnight solar degrees; add the fixed daily travel each day; discard full ecliptic lodge degrees to obtain each midnight solar degree.

sentences.zh: 黃道十二次宿度

translations.literal: Ecliptic twelve stations' lodge degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Ecliptic degrees of the twelve stations.

sentences.zh: 危十二度六四九一，入娵訾，辰在亥。

translations.literal: Rooftop 12 degrees 6491, entering Maidens' Mantle; the chronogram is in hai.
translations.idiomatic: Rooftop (Wei): 12°6491, entering Maidens' Mantle (Ziju zi); chronogram hai.

sentences.zh: 奎一度七三六二，入降婁，辰在戍。

translations.literal: Striding Legs one degree 7362, entering Sinking Barrens; the chronogram is in xu.
translations.idiomatic: Striding Legs (Kui): 1°7362, entering Sinking Barrens (Jiang lou); chronogram xu.

sentences.zh: 奎度四五六，入大梁，辰在酉。

translations.literal: Striding Legs degree 456, entering Great Bridge; the chronogram is in you.
translations.idiomatic: Striding Legs: 4°56, entering Great Bridge (Daliang); chronogram you.

sentences.zh: 胃三七度七四五六，入大梁，辰在酉。

translations.literal: Stomach 37 degrees 7456, entering Great Bridge; the chronogram is in you.
translations.idiomatic: Stomach (Wei): 37°7456, entering Great Bridge; chronogram you.

sentences.zh: 畢六度八八零五，入實沈，辰在申。

translations.literal: Net six degrees 8805, entering Established Quiescence; the chronogram is in shen.
translations.idiomatic: Net (Bi): 6°8805, entering Established Quiescence (Shishen); chronogram shen.

sentences.zh: 井八度三四九四，入鶉首，辰在未。

translations.literal: Well eight degrees 3494, entering Quail's Head; the chronogram is in wei.
translations.idiomatic: Well (Jing): 8°3494, entering Quail's Head (Chunshou); chronogram wei.

sentences.zh: 柳三度八六八零，入鶉火，辰在午。

translations.literal: Willow three degrees 8680, entering Quail's Fire; the chronogram is in wu.
translations.idiomatic: Willow (Liu): 3°8680, entering Quail's Fire (Chunhuo); chronogram wu.

sentences.zh: 張十五度二六零六，入鶉尾，辰在巳。

translations.literal: Extended Net fifteen degrees 2606, entering Quail's Tail; the chronogram is in si.
translations.idiomatic: Extended Net (Zhang): 15°2606, entering Quail's Tail (Chunwei); chronogram si.

sentences.zh: 軫十度零七九七，入壽星，辰在辰。

translations.literal: Chariot Shaft ten degrees 0797, entering Longevity Star; the chronogram is in chen.
translations.idiomatic: Chariot Shaft (Zhen): 10°0797, entering Longevity Star (Shouxing); chronogram chen.

sentences.zh: 氐一度一四五二，入大火，辰在卯。

translations.literal: Root one degree 1452, entering Great Fire; the chronogram is in mao.
translations.idiomatic: Root (Di): 1°1452, entering Great Fire (Dahuo); chronogram mao.

sentences.zh: 尾三度一一五，入析木，辰在寅。

translations.literal: Tail three degrees 115, entering Split Wood; the chronogram is in yin.
translations.idiomatic: Tail (Wei): 3°115, entering Split Wood (Ximu); chronogram yin.

sentences.zh: 鬥三度七六八五，入星紀，辰在醜。

translations.literal: Dipper three degrees 7685, entering Star Chronicle; the chronogram is in chou.
translations.idiomatic: Dipper (Dou): 3°7685, entering Star Chronicle (Xingji); chronogram chou.

sentences.zh: 女二度零六三八，入玄枵，辰在子。

translations.literal: Girl two degrees 0638, entering Dark Axletree; the chronogram is in zi.
translations.idiomatic: Girl (Nü): 2°0638, entering Dark Axletree (Xuanxiao); chronogram zi.

sentences.zh: 推日躔黃道入十二次時刻 置入次宿度，以入次日夜，以入次日夜半日度減之，餘以日周乘之，一分作百分。

translations.literal: To seek the time-of-day when the sun's ecliptic motion enters the twelve stations: set the entry lodge degree; with the entry night's midnight solar degree subtract; with the remainder multiply by the solar circuit, one part as one hundred parts.
translations.idiomatic: To find the time when solar motion enters each of the twelve stations: set the entry lodge degree; subtract the midnight solar degree on the entry night; multiply the remainder by the solar circuit, treating one part as one hundred.

sentences.zh: 爲實。

translations.literal: That is the dividend.
translations.idiomatic: That is the dividend.

sentences.zh: 以入次日夜半日度，與明日夜半日度相減，餘爲法。

translations.literal: Subtract the midnight solar degree on the entry night from the next day's midnight solar degree; the remainder is the divisor.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the entry night's midnight solar degree from the next night's midnight solar degree for the divisor.

sentences.zh: 實如法而一，各數，以發斂加時求之，即入次時刻。

translations.literal: Divide the dividend by the divisor to one for each number; seek by emission-contraction with time-of-day—that is the time of entry into the station.
translations.idiomatic: Divide dividend by divisor; apply emission-contraction with time-of-day to obtain the station-entry moment.

sentences.zh: ▲步月離

translations.literal: ▲ Step the moon's separation.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Lunar motion.

sentences.zh: 月平行度一十三度三十六分八十七秒半。

translations.literal: Moon's mean travel degree thirteen degrees thirty-six parts eighty-seven seconds and a half.
translations.idiomatic: Mean lunar travel: 13°36′87.5″ per day.

sentences.zh: 周限三百三十六、半之爲中限，又半之爲初限。

translations.literal: Cycle limit three hundred thirty-six; halved is the middle limit; halved again is the initial limit.
translations.idiomatic: Cycle limit: 336; half is the middle limit; half again is the initial limit.

sentences.zh: 限平行度零九分六十二秒。

translations.literal: Limit mean travel degree 0 parts 962 seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Limit mean travel: 0°0.962 per day.

sentences.zh: 太陽限行八分二十秒。

translations.literal: Sun's limit travel eight parts twenty seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Solar limit travel: 0°8′20″ per day.

sentences.zh: 上弦九十一度三十一發四十三秒太。

translations.literal: First quarter ninety-one degrees thirty-one parts forty-three seconds excess.
translations.idiomatic: First quarter: 91°31′43″ excess.

sentences.zh: 望一百八十二度六十二分八十七秒半。

translations.literal: Full moon one hundred eighty-two degrees sixty-two parts eighty-seven seconds and a half.

sentences.zh: 下弦二百七十三度九十四分三十一秒少。

translations.literal: Last quarter two hundred seventy-three degrees ninety-four parts thirty-one seconds deficit.
translations.idiomatic: Last quarter: 273°94′31″ deficit.

sentences.zh: 交終度三百六十三度七十九分三十四秒一九六。

translations.literal: Nodal cycle degree three hundred sixty-three degrees seventy-nine parts thirty-four seconds 196.
translations.idiomatic: Nodal cycle: 363°79′34.196.

sentences.zh: 朔平行度三百九十四度七八七一一五一六八七五。

translations.literal: Mean new-moon parallel degree 394 degrees 78 fen 71 miao 15151686875.
translations.idiomatic: Mean new-moon parallel motion: 394.78711516875°.

sentences.zh: 推朔後平交日 置交終分，風氣朔歷。

translations.literal: To seek the mean nodal day after new moon: set the nodal-cycle remainder; wind-qi new-moon sequence.
translations.idiomatic: To find the mean nodal day after new moon: set the nodal-cycle remainder and apply the solar-term and conjunction sequence.

sentences.zh: 減天正經朔交凡分，爲朔後平交日。

translations.literal: Subtract the celestial first-month mean new-moon nodal-entry total parts; that is the mean nodal day after new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the civil first-month mean new-moon nodal-entry parts to obtain the mean nodal day after new moon.

sentences.zh: 如推次月，累減交差二日三一八六九，得次月朔平交日。

translations.literal: To seek the next month, accumulate subtracting the nodal difference 2 days 31869; obtain the next month's mean nodal day after new moon.
translations.idiomatic: For the following month, subtract the nodal difference of 2 days 31869 repeatedly to obtain each month's mean nodal day after new moon.

sentences.zh: 不及減交差者，加交終減之，其交又在本月，爲重交月朔後平交日。

translations.literal: If the nodal difference cannot be subtracted, add the nodal cycle and subtract; the node again falls in this month—this is the double-nodal month's mean nodal day after new moon.
translations.idiomatic: If subtraction fails, add the nodal cycle and subtract again; when the node again falls within the month, this is the double-nodal month's mean nodal day after new moon.

sentences.zh: 每歲必有重交之月。

translations.literal: Every year necessarily has a double-nodal month.
translations.idiomatic: Every year necessarily contains one double-nodal month.

sentences.zh: 推平交入轉遲疾歷 置經朔遲疾歷，加入朔後平交日爲平交入轉。

translations.literal: To seek mean nodal entry into rotation slow-rapid sequence: set the mean new-moon slow-rapid sequence; add the mean nodal day after new moon for mean nodal entry into rotation.
translations.idiomatic: To find mean nodal entry into the rotation anomaly sequence: set the mean new-moon anomaly sequence and add the mean nodal day after new moon to obtain mean nodal rotation entry.

sentences.zh: 在轉中已下，其遲疾與經朔同，已上減去轉中疾交遲，遲交疾。

translations.literal: If below the rotation midpoint, its slow-rapid matches the mean new moon; if above, subtract the rotation midpoint—fast node slow, slow node fast.
translations.idiomatic: Below the rotation midpoint the anomaly matches the mean new moon; above it, subtract the midpoint—fast at the node becomes slow, slow becomes fast.

sentences.zh: 如推次月，累減交轉差三千四百二十三分七六，交差內減轉差數。

translations.literal: To seek the next month, accumulate subtracting the nodal-rotation difference 3423 parts 76; within the nodal difference subtract the rotation-difference number.
translations.idiomatic: For the following month, subtract the nodal-rotation difference of 3423.76 parts repeatedly, deducting the rotation difference from within the nodal difference.

sentences.zh: 即得。

translations.literal: Then it is obtained.
translations.idiomatic: The result follows.

sentences.zh: 如不及減，加轉中減之，亦遲疾相代。

translations.literal: If subtraction fails, add the rotation midpoint and subtract; slow and rapid likewise alternate in succession.
translations.idiomatic: If subtraction fails, add the rotation midpoint and subtract again; slow and rapid alternate as before.

sentences.zh: 推平交入限遲疾差 置平交入轉遲疾歷，依步氣朔內，推遲疾差，那得。

translations.literal: To seek mean nodal entry-limit slow-rapid difference: set mean nodal entry-rotation slow-rapid sequence; within Step Solar Terms and Conjunctions seek the slow-rapid difference—thereupon obtained.
translations.idiomatic: To find the mean nodal limit anomaly difference: set the mean nodal rotation-entry anomaly sequence and derive the anomaly difference by the solar-term and conjunction procedure.

sentences.zh: 推平交加減定差 置平交入限遲疾差，雙日率八百二十分乘之，以所入遲疾限下行度而一，即得。

translations.literal: To seek mean nodal crossing additive-subtractive fixed difference: set mean nodal entry-limit slow-rapid difference; multiply by the paired-day rate 820 parts; divide by the travel degrees within the slow-rapid limit entered—then obtained.
translations.idiomatic: To find the mean nodal crossing fixed correction: set the mean nodal limit anomaly difference, multiply by the paired-day rate of 820 parts, and divide by the travel degrees within the applicable anomaly limit.

sentences.zh: 在遲爲加，在疾爲減。

translations.literal: In slow it is add; in fast it is subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Add in the slow interval; subtract in the fast interval.

sentences.zh: 推經朔加時積 置經朔盈縮歷，見步氣朔內。

translations.literal: To seek mean new-moon time-of-day accumulation: set the mean new-moon expansion-contraction sequence; see within Step Solar Terms and Conjunctions.
translations.idiomatic: To find the mean new-moon time-of-day accumulation: set the mean new-moon expansion–contraction sequence, as in the solar-term and conjunction section.

sentences.zh: 在盈歷即爲加時中積，在縮歷加半歲周。

translations.literal: If in the expansion sequence, that is the time-of-day central accumulation; if in the contraction sequence, add half the year circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the expansion sequence it is the time-of-day central accumulation; in the contraction sequence add half the tropical year.

sentences.zh: 如推次月，累加朔策，滿歲周去之，即各朔加時中積，命日爲度。

translations.literal: To seek the next month, accumulate adding the new-moon divisor; when the year circuit is full remove it—then each new moon's time-of-day central accumulation; assign days as degrees.
translations.idiomatic: For the following month, add the synodic-month divisor repeatedly and discard the tropical year when full to obtain each conjunction's time-of-day central accumulation, naming days as degrees.

sentences.zh: 若月內有二交，後交即注前交經朔加時中積。

translations.literal: If within a month there are two nodes, the later node notes the former node's mean new-moon time-of-day central accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: When a month contains two nodes, the later node uses the former node's mean new-moon time-of-day central accumulation.

sentences.zh: 推正交距冬至加時黃道積度及宿次 置朔後平交日，以月平行乘之爲距後度，加以經朔加時中積，爲各月正交距冬至加時黃道積度。

translations.literal: To seek true nodal distance from winter solstice time-of-day ecliptic accumulated degrees and lodge positions: set the mean nodal day after new moon; multiply by mean lunar travel for the post-distance degrees; add the mean new-moon time-of-day central accumulation—for each month's true nodal distance from winter solstice time-of-day ecliptic accumulated degrees.
translations.idiomatic: To find the true node's ecliptic accumulation and lodge from the winter solstice time-of-day: set the mean nodal day after new moon, multiply by mean lunar travel for the post-node degrees, and add the mean new-moon time-of-day central accumulation to obtain each month's true nodal ecliptic accumulation from the winter solstice moment.

sentences.zh: 加冬至加時黃道日度，見日躔。

translations.literal: Add the winter solstice time-of-day ecliptic solar degree; see solar motion.
translations.idiomatic: Add the winter solstice ecliptic solar degree at time-of-day to inspect solar motion.

sentences.zh: 以黃道積度鈐減之，至不滿宿次，即正交月離。

translations.literal: Subtract by the ecliptic accumulated-degree tally until lodge positions no longer fill—then the true nodal month's separation.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract successive entries from the ecliptic accumulation tally until the remainder falls within one lodge to obtain the true nodal month's lodge.

sentences.zh: 如推次月，累減月平交朔差一度四六三一零二。

translations.literal: To seek the next month, accumulate subtracting the mean nodal new-moon difference 1 degree 463102.
translations.idiomatic: For the following month, subtract the mean nodal new-moon difference of 1.463102° repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 以交終度減天周，其數宜爲一度四六四零八零。

translations.literal: Subtract the nodal-cycle degree from the celestial circuit; the number should be 1 degree 464080.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the nodal-cycle arc from the celestial circuit; the value should be 1.464080°.

sentences.zh: 遇重交月，同次朔。

translations.literal: On encountering a double-nodal month, treat it like the next new moon.
translations.idiomatic: In a double-nodal month, proceed as for the next mean new moon.

sentences.zh: 後仿此。

translations.literal: Thereafter imitate this.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the same rule thereafter.

sentences.zh: ▲黃道積度鈐

translations.literal: ▲ Ecliptic accumulated-degree tally.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Ecliptic accumulation tally.

sentences.zh: 表格略

translations.literal: Table abbreviated.
translations.idiomatic: [Table omitted.]

sentences.zh: 推正交日辰時刻 置朔後症交日，加經朔，去紀法，以平交定差加減之，其日命甲子算外，小余依發斂加時求之，即得正交日辰時刻。

translations.literal: To seek true nodal day double-hour and quarter-hour: set the mean nodal day after new moon (text reads symptom-node day), add the mean new moon, remove the era cycle, add or subtract the mean nodal fixed difference; for the day count from jiazi beyond the count, for the small remainder seek by emission-contraction with time-of-day—then obtain the true nodal day, double-hour, and quarter-hour.
translations.idiomatic: To find the true nodal date and time: set the mean nodal day after new moon (the text reads 症交), add the mean new moon, discard the era cycle, apply the mean nodal fixed correction, count the day from jiazi, and derive the quarter-hour from the small remainder by emission–contraction with time-of-day.

sentences.zh: 如推次月，累加交終，滿紀去之。

translations.literal: To seek the next month, accumulate adding the nodal cycle; when the era cycle is full remove it.
translations.idiomatic: For the following month, add the nodal cycle repeatedly and discard the era cycle when full.

sentences.zh: 如遇重交，再加交終。

translations.literal: If encountering double nodal, again add the nodal cycle.
translations.idiomatic: In a double-nodal month, add the nodal cycle once more.

sentences.zh: 推四正赤道宿次 置冬至赤道日度，以氣象限累加之，滿赤道積度去之，爲四正加時赤道日度。

translations.literal: To seek the four cardinal equatorial lodge positions: set the winter solstice equatorial solar degree; accumulate adding the qi quadrant; when the equatorial accumulation is full remove it—for the four cardinal time-of-day equatorial solar degrees.
translations.idiomatic: To find the four cardinal equatorial lodges: set the winter solstice equatorial solar degree, add the qi quadrant repeatedly, and discard the equatorial accumulation when full to obtain the four cardinal equatorial degrees at time-of-day.

sentences.zh: ▲赤道積度鈐

translations.literal: ▲ Equatorial accumulated-degree tally.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Equatorial accumulation tally.

sentences.zh: 表格略

translations.literal: Table abbreviated.
translations.idiomatic: [Table omitted.]

sentences.zh: 推正交黃道在二至後初末限 置正交距冬至加時黃道積度，在半歲周已下爲冬至後，已上減去半歲周，餘爲夏至後。

translations.literal: To seek true nodal ecliptic initial-final limit after the two solstices: set true nodal distance from winter solstice time-of-day ecliptic accumulated degree; if below half the year circuit it is after winter solstice; if above, subtract half the year circuit—the remainder is after summer solstice.
translations.idiomatic: To find the initial and final limits of the true nodal ecliptic arc after the solstices: set the true nodal ecliptic accumulation from the winter solstice moment; below half the tropical year counts as post-winter-solstice, above that subtract half the year for post-summer-solstice.

sentences.zh: 又視二至後度分，在氣象限已下爲初限，已上用減半歲周，餘爲末限。

translations.literal: Again inspect the degrees after the two solstices; if below the qi quadrant it is the initial limit; if above, subtract half the year circuit—the remainder is the final limit.
translations.idiomatic: Inspect the arc after each solstice: below the qi quadrant is the initial limit; above it, subtract half the tropical year for the final limit.

sentences.zh: 推次月者，若本月初限，則累減月平交朔差，餘爲次月初限。

translations.literal: To seek the next month: if this month is initial limit, accumulate subtracting the mean nodal new-moon difference—the remainder is the next month's initial limit.
translations.idiomatic: For the next month: if the current month is in the initial limit, subtract the mean nodal new-moon difference repeatedly; the remainder is the next month's initial limit.

sentences.zh: 不及減者，反減月平交朔差，餘爲次月末限。

translations.literal: If subtraction fails, reverse-subtract the mean nodal new-moon difference—the remainder is the next month's final limit.
translations.idiomatic: If subtraction fails, subtract the mean nodal new-moon difference in reverse; the remainder is the next month's final limit.

sentences.zh: 若本月末限則累加月平交朔差，爲次月天限，至滿氣象限，以減半歲周，餘爲次月初限。

translations.literal: If this month is final limit, accumulate adding the mean nodal new-moon difference for the next month's heaven limit; when the qi quadrant is full, subtract half the year circuit—the remainder is the next month's initial limit.
translations.idiomatic: If the current month is in the final limit, add the mean nodal new-moon difference repeatedly for the next month's final interval; when the qi quadrant is full, subtract half the tropical year—the remainder is the next month's initial limit.

sentences.zh: 推定差度 置初末限，以象極總差一分六零五五零八乘之，即爲定差度。

translations.literal: To seek the fixed difference degree: set the initial or final limit; multiply by the quadrant-pole total difference 1 part 605508—the result is the fixed difference degree.
translations.idiomatic: To find the fixed-difference degree: set the initial or final limit and multiply by the quadrant-to-pole total difference of 1.605508 to obtain the fixed difference in degrees.

sentences.zh: 象極總差，是以象限除極差，其數宜爲一十六分零五四四二。

translations.literal: Quadrant-pole total difference is the pole difference divided by the quadrant; the number should be 16 parts 05442.
translations.idiomatic: The quadrant-to-pole total difference divides the pole difference by the quadrant; the value should be 16.05442 parts.

sentences.zh: 如推次月初限則累減，末限則累加，俱以極平差二十三分四九零二加減之。

translations.literal: To seek the next month's initial limit, accumulate subtracting; for the final limit, accumulate adding—both add or subtract by the pole mean difference 23 parts 4902.
translations.idiomatic: For the next month's initial limit subtract the pole mean difference of 23.4902 parts repeatedly; for the final limit add it repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 極平差，是以月平交朔差，乘象極總差，其數宜爲二十三分五零四九。

translations.literal: Pole mean difference is the mean nodal new-moon difference multiplied by the quadrant-pole total difference; the number should be 23 parts 5049.
translations.idiomatic: The pole mean difference is the mean nodal new-moon difference multiplied by the quadrant-to-pole total difference; the value should be 23.5049 parts.

sentences.zh: 推距差度 置極差十四度六六，減去定差度，即得。

translations.literal: To seek the distance-difference degree: set the pole difference 14 degrees 66; subtract the fixed difference degree—then obtained.
translations.idiomatic: To find the distance-difference degree: set the pole difference at 14.66° and subtract the fixed-difference degree.

sentences.zh: 求次月，以極平差加減之。

translations.literal: To seek the next month, add or subtract by the pole mean difference.
translations.idiomatic: For the following month, add or subtract the pole mean difference.

sentences.zh: 初限加，末限減。

translations.literal: Initial limit: add; final limit: subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Add in the initial limit; subtract in the final limit.

sentences.zh: 推定限度 置定差度，以定極總差一分六三七一零七乘之，定極總差，是以極差除二十四度，其數宜爲一度六三七一零七。

translations.literal: To seek the fixed limit degree: set the fixed difference degree; multiply by the fixed-pole total difference 1 part 637107; fixed-pole total difference is the pole difference divided by 24 degrees—the number should be 1 degree 637107.
translations.idiomatic: To find the fixed-limit degree: set the fixed-difference degree and multiply by the fixed-pole total difference of 1.637107; this is the pole difference divided by 24°, which should equal 1.637107°.

sentences.zh: 所得視正交在冬至後爲減，夏至後爲加，皆置九十八度加減之，即得。

translations.literal: The product obtained: if the true node is after winter solstice it is subtract; after summer solstice it is add; in all cases set 98 degrees and add or subtract—then obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the product as subtraction after the winter solstice and addition after the summer solstice, in each case against the base of 98°.

sentences.zh: 推月道與赤道正交宿度 正交在冬至後，置春正赤道積度，以距差度初 限加末限減之，在夏至後，置秋正赤道積度，以距差初限減末限加之。

translations.literal: To seek the lunar-path and equator true-nodal lodge degree: if the true node is after winter solstice, set the spring first-month equatorial accumulation; with the distance-difference degree, initial limit add and final limit subtract; if after summer solstice, set the autumn first-month equatorial accumulation; with the distance difference, initial limit subtract and final limit add.
translations.idiomatic: To find the lunar-path and equator true-nodal lodge: after the winter solstice set the spring equinox accumulation and add the distance difference in the initial limit while subtracting it in the final limit; after the summer solstice set the autumn equinox accumulation and subtract in the initial limit while adding in the final limit.

sentences.zh: 得數，滿赤道積度鈐去之，即得。

translations.literal: Obtain the number; when the equatorial accumulation tally is full remove it—then obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Discard full cycles from the equatorial accumulation tally to obtain the lodge.

sentences.zh: 推月道與赤道正交後積度併入初末限 視月道與赤道正交所入某宿次，即置本宿赤道全度，減去月道與赤道正交宿度，差爲正後積度。

translations.literal: To seek lunar-path and equator true-nodal post-accumulation merged into initial-final limits: inspect which lodge the lunar-path and equator true nodal crossing enters; then set this lodge's full equatorial degree and subtract the lunar-path and equator true-nodal lodge degree—the difference is the post-true accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: To find post-true-nodal accumulation with initial and final limits: identify the lodge of true nodal crossing, set that lodge's full equatorial arc, subtract the true-nodal lodge degree, and the remainder is the post-true accumulation.

sentences.zh: 以赤道各宿全度累中之，滿氣象限去之，爲半交後。

translations.literal: Accumulate through each lodge's full equatorial degree; when the qi quadrant is full remove it—for post-half-node.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulate each lodge's full equatorial arc and discard the qi quadrant when full to obtain the post-half-node interval.

sentences.zh: 又滿去之，爲中交後。

translations.literal: Again when full remove it—for post-middle-node.
translations.idiomatic: Discard the qi quadrant again when full to obtain the post-middle-node interval.

sentences.zh: 再滿去之，爲半交後。

translations.literal: Again when full remove it—for post-half-node.
translations.idiomatic: Discard once more when full to obtain the second post-half-node interval.

sentences.zh: 視各交積度，在半象限以焉爲初限，以上覆減象限，餘爲末限。

translations.literal: Inspect each crossing accumulation; if below half the quadrant, below counts as initial limit; if above, overlay-subtract the quadrant—the remainder is final limit.
translations.idiomatic: For each crossing accumulation: below half the quadrant is the initial limit; above it, subtract the quadrant from above for the final limit.

sentences.zh: 推定差 置每交定限度，與初末限相乘，得數，千約之爲度，即得。

translations.literal: To seek the fixed difference: set each crossing's fixed limit degree; multiply by the initial or final limit; obtain the number; reduce by a thousand to degrees—then obtained.
translations.idiomatic: To find the fixed difference: multiply each crossing's fixed-limit degree by the initial or final limit, scale by a thousand, and express the result in degrees.

sentences.zh: 正交、中交後爲加，半交後爲減。

translations.literal: After true nodal and middle nodal crossings it is add; after half-node crossings it is subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Add after true and middle nodal crossings; subtract after half-node crossings.

sentences.zh: 推月道定積度及宿次 置月道與赤道各交後每宿積度，以定差加減之，爲各交月道積度。

translations.literal: To seek lunar-path fixed accumulation and lodge positions: set each lodge's accumulated degree after each lunar-path and equator crossing; add or subtract by the fixed difference—for each crossing's lunar-path accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: To find the lunar-path fixed accumulation and lodge: set the per-lodge accumulation after each crossing, apply the fixed difference, and obtain each crossing's lunar-path accumulation.

sentences.zh: 加月道與赤道正交定宿度，共爲正交後宿度。

translations.literal: Add the lunar-path and equator true-nodal fixed lodge degree; together they are the post-true-nodal lodge degree.
translations.idiomatic: Add the true-nodal fixed lodge degree on the lunar path and equator to obtain the post-true-nodal lodge degree.

sentences.zh: 以前宿定積度減之，即得各交月道宿次。

translations.literal: Subtract the previous lodge's fixed accumulation; then obtain each crossing's lunar-path lodge position.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the preceding lodge's fixed accumulation to obtain each crossing's lunar-path lodge.

sentences.zh: ▲活象限例

translations.literal: ▲ Active-quadrant-limit examples.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Examples for the active quadrant limit.

sentences.zh: 置正交後宿次，加前交後半交末宿定積度。

translations.literal: Set the post-true-nodal lodge position; add the previous crossing's post-half-node final-lodge fixed accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: Set the post-true-nodal lodge and add the previous crossing's post-half-node final-lodge fixed accumulation.

sentences.zh: 爲活象限。

translations.literal: This is the active quadrant limit.
translations.idiomatic: This yields the active quadrant limit.

sentences.zh: 如正交後宿次度少，加前交不及數，卻置正交後宿次加氣象限即是。

translations.literal: If the post-true-nodal lodge degree is small and adding the previous crossing falls short, instead set the post-true-nodal lodge and add the qi quadrant—that suffices.
translations.idiomatic: If the post-true-nodal lodge degree is too small to absorb the previous crossing's addition, set the post-true-nodal lodge and add the qi quadrant instead.

sentences.zh: 如遇換交之月，置正交後宿次，以前交前半交末宿定積度加之，爲換交活象限。

translations.literal: If encountering a node-shift month, set the post-true-nodal lodge and add the previous crossing's first-half final-lodge fixed accumulation—for the node-shift active quadrant limit.
translations.idiomatic: In a node-shift month, set the post-true-nodal lodge and add the previous crossing's first-half final-lodge fixed accumulation to obtain the node-shift active quadrant limit.

sentences.zh: 假如前交正交是軫，後交正交是角，其前交欠一軫。

translations.literal: Suppose the previous crossing's true node is Axletree and the later crossing's true node is Horn; the previous crossing lacks one Axletree.
translations.idiomatic: Suppose the previous true node lies in Axletree (Zhen) and the later in Horn (Jiao), with the previous crossing one Axletree lodge short.

sentences.zh: 求活象限者，置正交後宿次，不從翼下取定積度加之，仍於軫下取定積度也。

translations.literal: To seek the active quadrant limit: set the post-true-nodal lodge; do not take the fixed accumulation from below Wings to add; still take the fixed accumulation from below Axletree.
translations.idiomatic: To find the active quadrant limit: set the post-true-nodal lodge, do not add the fixed accumulation from below Wings (Yi), but still add that from below Axletree (Zhen).

sentences.zh: 又如前交、正交是軫，後交、正交是翼，其前交多一翼。

translations.literal: Again suppose the previous crossing's true node is Axletree and the later crossing's true node is Wings; the previous crossing has one Wings excess.
translations.idiomatic: Again, if the previous true node is Axletree and the later is Wings (Yi), the previous crossing exceeds by one Wings lodge.

sentences.zh: 求活象限者，置正交後宿次，不從翼下取定積度加之，仍於張下取定積度也。

translations.literal: To seek the active quadrant limit: set the post-true-nodal lodge; do not take the fixed accumulation from below Wings to add; still take the fixed accumulation from below Extended Net.
translations.idiomatic: To find the active quadrant limit: set the post-true-nodal lodge, do not add from below Wings, but add the fixed accumulation from below Extended Net (Zhang).

sentences.zh: 推相距日 置定上弦大餘，減去定朔大餘，即得。

translations.literal: To seek the interval in days: set the fixed first-quarter large remainder; subtract the fixed new-moon large remainder—then obtained.
translations.idiomatic: To find the interval in days: subtract the fixed new-moon large remainder from the fixed first-quarter large remainder.

sentences.zh: 上弦至望，望至下弦，下弦至朔仿此。

translations.literal: First quarter to full moon, full moon to last quarter, last quarter to new moon imitate this.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the same method from first quarter to full moon, full moon to last quarter, and last quarter to new moon.

sentences.zh: 不及減者，加紀法減之。

translations.literal: If subtraction fails, add the era cycle and subtract.
translations.idiomatic: If subtraction fails, add the era cycle and subtract again.

sentences.zh: 推定朔弦望入盈歷及盈縮定差 置各月朔弦望入盈縮歷，以朔弦望加減差加減之，並在步氣朔內。

translations.literal: To seek fixed new-moon, quarter, and full-moon entry into expansion sequence and expansion-contraction fixed difference: set each month's new-moon, quarter, and full-moon entry into expansion-contraction sequence; add or subtract by the new-moon, quarter, and full-moon additive-subtractive difference—all within Step Solar Terms and Conjunctions.
translations.idiomatic: To find true new moon, quarters, and full moons entering the equation sequence and fixed equation correction: set each month's equation sequence at conjunction and quarters, apply the conjunction–quarter correction, all by the solar-term and conjunction procedure.

sentences.zh: 爲定盈縮歷。

translations.literal: This is the fixed expansion-contraction sequence.
translations.idiomatic: This is the true equation sequence.

sentences.zh: 視盈歷在盈初限下爲盈初已上用減半歲周，餘爲盈末限。

translations.literal: Inspect the expansion sequence: if below the expansion-initial limit it is expansion-initial; if above, subtract half the year circuit—the remainder is expansion-final.
translations.idiomatic: In the expansion sequence, below the expansion-initial interval is expansion-initial; above it, subtract half the tropical year for expansion-final.

sentences.zh: 縮歷在縮初限已下爲縮初限，已上用減半歲周，餘爲縮末限。

translations.literal: Contraction sequence at or below contraction-initial limit is contraction-initial; if above, subtract half the year circuit—the remainder is contraction-final.
translations.idiomatic: In the contraction sequence, at or below the contraction-initial interval is contraction-initial; above it, subtract half the tropical year for contraction-final.

sentences.zh: 依步氣朔內求盈縮差，爲盈縮定差。

translations.literal: Within Step Solar Terms and Conjunctions seek the expansion-contraction difference—for the expansion-contraction fixed difference.
translations.idiomatic: Derive the equation correction by the solar-term and conjunction procedure to obtain the fixed equation correction.

sentences.zh: 推定朔弦望加時中積 置定盈縮歷，如是盈歷在朔，便爲加時中積，在上弦加氣象限，在望加半歲周，在下弦加三象限。

translations.literal: To seek fixed new-moon, quarter, and full-moon time-of-day central accumulation: set the fixed expansion-contraction sequence; if expansion sequence at new moon, it is the time-of-day central accumulation; at first quarter add the qi quadrant; at full moon add half the year circuit; at last quarter add three quadrants.
translations.idiomatic: To find the true conjunction and quarters' time-of-day central accumulation: set the true equation sequence; at new moon in expansion it is the central accumulation; add the qi quadrant at first quarter, half the tropical year at full moon, and three quadrants at last quarter.

sentences.zh: 如是縮歷在朔，加半歲周。

translations.literal: If contraction sequence at new moon, add half the year circuit.
translations.idiomatic: At new moon in the contraction sequence, add half the tropical year.

sentences.zh: 在上弦加三象限，在望便爲加時中積，在下弦加氣象限，加後滿周天去之。

translations.literal: At first quarter add three quadrants; at full moon it is the time-of-day central accumulation; at last quarter add the qi quadrant; after adding, when the full circuit is full remove it.
translations.idiomatic: Add three quadrants at first quarter; at full moon use the central accumulation directly; add the qi quadrant at last quarter; discard the full celestial circuit when the sum is full.

sentences.zh: 推黃朔弦望加時中定積度 置定朔弦望加時中積，以其下盈縮定差盈加縮之，即得。

translations.literal: To seek ecliptic new-moon, quarter, and full-moon time-of-day central fixed accumulated degree: set the fixed new-moon, quarter, and full-moon time-of-day central accumulation; with the expansion-contraction fixed difference below, expansion add and contraction subtract—then obtained.
translations.idiomatic: To find the ecliptic central fixed accumulation at true new moon, quarters, and full moon: set the time-of-day central accumulation and add or subtract the underlying fixed equation correction—add for expansion, subtract for contraction.

sentences.zh: 推赤道加時積度及宿次 置黃道加時定積度，在周天象限已下爲至後，已上去之爲分後，滿兩象限去之爲至後，滿三象限去之爲分後。

translations.literal: To seek equatorial time-of-day accumulated degree and lodge positions: set the ecliptic time-of-day fixed accumulated degree; if below the full-circuit quadrant it is post-solstice; if above, remove it for post-equinox; when two quadrants are full remove for post-solstice; when three quadrants are full remove for post-equinox.
translations.idiomatic: To find the equatorial accumulation and lodge at time-of-day: set the ecliptic fixed accumulation at time-of-day; below one celestial quadrant is post-solstice, above is post-equinox; discard two quadrants for post-solstice and three for post-equinox.

sentences.zh: 置分至後黃道積度，以立成內分至後積度減之，餘以其下赤道度率乘之，如黃道度率而一，得數加入分至後積度，次以所去象限合之，爲赤道加時定積度。

translations.literal: Set the post-equinox or post-solstice ecliptic accumulation; subtract the post-equinox or post-solstice accumulation within the ready reckoners; with the remainder multiply by the equatorial degree-rate below; divide by the ecliptic degree-rate to one; obtain the number and add to the post-equinox or post-solstice accumulation; next combine the quadrants removed—for the equatorial time-of-day fixed accumulated degree.
translations.idiomatic: Set the post-solstice or post-equinox ecliptic accumulation, subtract the tabulated value, multiply the remainder by the equatorial rate and divide by the ecliptic rate, add to the interval accumulation, then restore the discarded quadrants to obtain the equatorial fixed accumulation at time-of-day.

sentences.zh: 置赤度加時定積度，加入天正冬至加時赤道日度，滿赤道積度鈐去之，得定朔弦望赤道加時宿次。

translations.literal: Set the equatorial time-of-day fixed accumulated degree; add the celestial first-month winter solstice time-of-day equatorial solar degree; when the equatorial accumulation tally is full remove it—obtain the fixed new-moon, quarter, and full-moon equatorial time-of-day lodge positions.
translations.idiomatic: Add the civil winter solstice equatorial degree at time-of-day to the equatorial fixed accumulation and discard full cycles from the equatorial tally to obtain the true conjunction and quarters' equatorial lodges at time-of-day.

sentences.zh: 推正半合交後積度 置定朔弦望加時赤道宿次，視朔弦望在何交後，正半、中半。

translations.literal: To seek post-true, post-half, and combined-crossing accumulation: set the fixed new-moon, quarter, and full-moon equatorial time-of-day lodge positions; inspect whether the new moon, quarter, or full moon falls after which crossing—true-half, middle-half.
translations.idiomatic: To find the post-true, post-half, and combined-crossing accumulation: set the equatorial lodge at true conjunction or quarters and determine whether the event falls after the true-half or middle-half crossing.

sentences.zh: 即以交生積度，在朔望加時赤道宿前一宿者加之，即爲正半中交後積度，滿氣象限去之，爲正半中換交。

translations.literal: Then apply the crossing-generated accumulation; where it lies in the lodge before the new-moon or full-moon time-of-day equatorial lodge, add it—for the post-true, post-middle accumulation; when the qi quadrant is full remove it—for post-true, post-middle node-shift.
translations.idiomatic: Add the crossing-generated accumulation from the preceding lodge to obtain the post-true or post-middle accumulation, discarding the qi quadrant when full to mark a node shift.

sentences.zh: 推初末限 視正半中交後積度，在半象已下爲初限，已上覆減氣象限，餘爲末限。

translations.literal: To seek initial-final limits: inspect the post-true or post-middle accumulation; if below half the quadrant it is initial limit; if above, overlay-subtract the qi quadrant—the remainder is final limit.
translations.idiomatic: To find the initial and final limits: if the post-true or post-middle accumulation is below half the quadrant it is initial; above, subtract the qi quadrant for the final limit.

sentences.zh: 推月道與赤道定差 置其交定限度，與初末限相減相乘，所得，千約之爲度，即定差。

translations.literal: To seek lunar-path and equator fixed difference: set that crossing's fixed limit degree; with initial or final limit subtract and multiply; the product, reduced by a thousand to degrees, is the fixed difference.
translations.idiomatic: To find the lunar-path and equator fixed difference: multiply the crossing's fixed-limit degree by the initial or final limit, scale by a thousand, and express in degrees.

sentences.zh: 在正交、中交爲加。

translations.literal: At true nodal and middle nodal crossings it is add.
translations.idiomatic: Add at true and middle nodal crossings.

sentences.zh: 在半交爲減。

translations.literal: At half-node crossings it is subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract at half-node crossings.

sentences.zh: 推定朔弦望加時月道宿次 置定朔弦望加時月道定積度，取交後月道定積度，取交後月道定積度，在所置罕前一宿者減之，即得。

translations.literal: To seek fixed new-moon, quarter, and full-moon time-of-day lunar-path lodge positions: set the fixed new-moon, quarter, and full-moon time-of-day lunar-path fixed accumulated degree; take the post-crossing lunar-path fixed accumulated degree; take the post-crossing lunar-path fixed accumulated degree; where it lies in the lodge before that set, subtract it—then obtained.
translations.idiomatic: To find the lunar-path lodge at true new moon, quarters, and full moon at time-of-day: set the lunar-path fixed accumulation at time-of-day, take the post-crossing lunar-path fixed accumulation, and subtract that of the lodge before the one set.

sentences.zh: 遇轉交則前積度多，所置積度少爲不及減。

translations.literal: On encountering node shift the prior accumulation is greater and the accumulation set is smaller—subtraction is insufficient.
translations.idiomatic: At a node shift the prior accumulation is larger and the current value smaller, so subtraction fails.

sentences.zh: 從半轉正，加其交活象限減之。

translations.literal: From half turning to true, add its crossing's active quadrant limit and subtract.
translations.idiomatic: When shifting from half-node to true-node, add the active quadrant limit for that crossing and subtract.

sentences.zh: 從正轉半，從半轉中，從中轉半，皆加氣象限減之。

translations.literal: From true turning to half, from half turning to middle, from middle turning to half—all add the qi quadrant and subtract.
translations.idiomatic: From true to half, half to middle, or middle to half, add the qi quadrant and subtract in each case.

sentences.zh: 推夜半入轉日 置經朔弦望遲疾歷，以定朔弦望加減差加減之。

translations.literal: To seek midnight entry into rotation day: set the mean new-moon, quarter, and full-moon slow-rapid sequence; add or subtract by the fixed new-moon, quarter, and full-moon additive-subtractive difference.
translations.idiomatic: To find midnight rotation-entry day: set the mean conjunction and quarter anomaly sequences and apply the true conjunction–quarter correction.

sentences.zh: 大疾歷，便爲定朔弦望加時入轉日。

translations.literal: The great-fast sequence is then the fixed new-moon, quarter, and full-moon time-of-day entry into rotation day.
translations.idiomatic: In the fast sequence this is the rotation-entry day at true conjunction or quarter at time-of-day.

sentences.zh: 在遲歷，用加轉中置定朔弦望加時入轉日，以定朔弦望小余減之，爲夜半入轉日，遇入轉日少不及減者，加轉終減之。

translations.literal: In the slow sequence, use adding the rotation midpoint to set the fixed new-moon, quarter, and full-moon time-of-day entry into rotation day; subtract the fixed new-moon, quarter, and full-moon small remainder—for midnight entry into rotation day; if the rotation-entry day is small and subtraction fails, add the rotation cycle and subtract.
translations.idiomatic: In the slow sequence add the rotation midpoint to the time-of-day rotation-entry day and subtract the small remainder for midnight entry; if the entry day is too small, add the rotation cycle and subtract again.

sentences.zh: 推加時入轉度 置定朔弦望小余，去秒，取夜半入轉日下轉定度乘之，萬約之爲分，即得。

translations.literal: To seek time-of-day entry into rotation degrees: set the fixed new-moon, quarter, and full-moon small remainder; remove seconds; take the rotation fixed degree below the midnight rotation-entry day and multiply; reduce by ten thousand to fen—then obtained.
translations.idiomatic: To find rotation degrees at time-of-day: take the small remainder without seconds, multiply by the fixed rotation degree under the midnight rotation-entry day, and scale by ten thousand to obtain fen.

sentences.zh: ▲遲疾轉定度鈐

translations.literal: ▲ Slow-rapid rotation fixed-degree tally.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Slow–rapid rotation fixed-degree tally.

sentences.zh: 表格略

translations.literal: Table abbreviated.
translations.idiomatic: [Table omitted.]

sentences.zh: 推定朔弦望夜半入轉積度及宿次 置定朔弦望加時月道定積度，減去加時入轉度，爲夜半積度。

translations.literal: To seek fixed new-moon, quarter, and full-moon midnight entry into rotation accumulated degree and lodge positions: set the fixed new-moon, quarter, and full-moon time-of-day lunar-path fixed accumulated degree; subtract the time-of-day entry into rotation degrees—for midnight accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: To find the midnight rotation accumulation and lodge for true new moon, quarters, and full moon: subtract the time-of-day rotation degrees from the lunar-path fixed accumulation at time-of-day to obtain the midnight accumulation.

sentences.zh: 如朔弦望加時定積度初換交，則不及減，半正相接，用活象限，正半、中半相接，用氣象限加之，然後減加時入轉度，則正者爲後年，後年爲中，中爲前半，前半爲正。

translations.literal: If at new/first-quarter/full/last-quarter time-of-event fixed accumulation the node first changes, then subtraction is insufficient; when half and major adjoin, use the variable quadrant; when major-half and middle-half adjoin, add the qi quadrant, then subtract the time-of-event rotation-entry degrees—then major becomes later half, later half becomes middle, middle becomes first half, first half becomes major.
translations.idiomatic: If the fixed accumulation at new moon, first quarter, full moon, or last quarter first crosses a node at time-of-event, subtraction falls short. Where half and major adjoin, apply the variable quadrant; where major-half and middle-half adjoin, add the qi quadrant; then subtract the rotation degrees entered at time-of-event. Major becomes later half, later half middle, middle first half, and first half major.

sentences.zh: 置朔弦望夜半月道定積度，依推定朔弦望加時月道宿次法減之，爲夜半宿次。

translations.literal: Set the new/first-quarter/full/last-quarter midnight lunar-path fixed accumulated degrees; by the method for deriving time-of-event lunar-path lodge positions, subtract to obtain the midnight lodge position.
translations.idiomatic: Set the midnight lunar-path fixed accumulation for new moon, first quarter, full moon, or last quarter; subtract by the procedure for time-of-event lunar-path lodge positions to obtain the midnight lodge.

sentences.zh: 推晨昏入轉日及轉度 置夜半入轉日，以定盈縮歷檢立成日下晨分加之，爲晨入轉日滿轉終去之。

translations.literal: Derive morning-evening rotation-entry day and rotation degrees: Set midnight rotation-entry day; from the fixed expansion-contraction sequence inspect the ready reckoner and add the morning fraction under that day—this is morning rotation-entry day; when full, remove the rotation period.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive morning-and-evening rotation-entry day and rotation degrees: Set the midnight rotation-entry day, look up the morning fraction for that day in the fixed expansion–contraction ready reckoner and add it to obtain the morning rotation-entry day, discarding the rotation period when full.

sentences.zh: 置其日晨分，取夜半入轉日下轉定度乘之，萬約爲分，爲晨轉度。

translations.literal: Set that day's morning fraction; take the fixed rotation degree under midnight rotation-entry day and multiply; reduce by ten thousand for fen—this is morning rotation degree.
translations.idiomatic: Set the day's morning fraction, multiply by the fixed rotation degree under the midnight rotation-entry day, scale by ten thousand to obtain fen, and the product is the morning rotation degree.

sentences.zh: 如求昏轉日轉度，依法檢日下昏分，即得。

translations.literal: To seek evening rotation day and rotation degree, by the method inspect the evening fraction under the day—then obtained.
translations.idiomatic: To find the evening rotation day and rotation degree, look up the evening fraction for that day by the same procedure.

sentences.zh: 推晨昏轉積度及宿次 置朔弦望夜半月道定積度，加晨轉度，爲晨轉積度。

translations.literal: Derive morning-evening rotation accumulated degrees and lodge positions: Set new/first-quarter/full/last-quarter midnight lunar-path fixed accumulated degrees; add morning rotation degree—this is morning rotation accumulated degree.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive morning-and-evening rotation accumulated degrees and lodge positions: Set the midnight lunar-path fixed accumulation for new moon, first quarter, full moon, or last quarter and add the morning rotation degree to obtain the morning rotation accumulation.

sentences.zh: 如求昏轉積度，則加昏轉度，滿氣象限去之，則換交。

translations.literal: To seek evening rotation accumulated degree, then add evening rotation degree; when full, remove the qi quadrant—then the node changes.
translations.idiomatic: For the evening rotation accumulation, add the evening rotation degree; when the sum reaches the qi quadrant, discard it—this marks a node change.

sentences.zh: 若推夜半積度之時，因朔弦望加時定積不及減轉度，以半正相接，而加活象限之者，今復換正交，則以活象限減之。

translations.literal: If when deriving midnight accumulated degree, because new/first-quarter/full/last-quarter time-of-event fixed accumulation could not subtract rotation degree, half and major adjoin and the variable quadrant was added—now again changing major node, then subtract by the variable quadrant.
translations.idiomatic: If, when deriving the midnight accumulation, the time-of-event fixed accumulation could not subtract the rotation degree and half and major adjoined so that the variable quadrant was added, then on a further change to the major node subtract the variable quadrant instead.

sentences.zh: 置晨轉積度，依前法減之，爲晨分宿次。

translations.literal: Set morning rotation accumulated degree; subtract by the preceding method—this is morning-fraction lodge position.
translations.idiomatic: Set the morning rotation accumulation and subtract by the preceding method to obtain the morning-fraction lodge.

sentences.zh: 置昏轉積度，依法減之，爲昏分宿次。

translations.literal: Set evening rotation accumulated degree; subtract by the method—this is evening-fraction lodge position.
translations.idiomatic: Set the evening rotation accumulation and subtract by the same method to obtain the evening-fraction lodge.

sentences.zh: 推相距度 朔與上弦相距，上弦與望相距，用昏轉積度。

translations.literal: Derive separation degrees: New moon to first quarter, first quarter to full moon—use evening rotation accumulated degree.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive separation degrees: From new moon to first quarter and from first quarter to full moon, use the evening rotation accumulation.

sentences.zh: 望與下弦相距，下弦與朔相距，用晨轉積度。

translations.literal: Full moon to last quarter, last quarter to new moon—use morning rotation accumulated degree.
translations.idiomatic: From full moon to last quarter and from last quarter to new moon, use the morning rotation accumulation.

sentences.zh: 置後段晨昏轉積度，視與前段同交者，竟以前段晨昏轉積度減之，餘爲相距度。

translations.literal: Set the later segment's morning-evening rotation accumulated degree; if it shares a node with the earlier segment, subtract entirely by the earlier segment's morning-evening rotation accumulated degree—the remainder is separation degree.
translations.idiomatic: Set the later segment's morning-or-evening rotation accumulation; if it lies on the same node as the earlier segment, subtract the earlier segment's morning-or-evening rotation accumulation in full—the remainder is the separation degree.

sentences.zh: 若後段與前段接兩交者，從正入半，從半入中，從中入半，加氣象限。

translations.literal: If later and earlier segments adjoin two nodes, from major entering half, from half entering middle, from middle entering half—add the qi quadrant.
translations.idiomatic: If the later and earlier segments span two nodes—from major to half, half to middle, or middle to half—add the qi quadrant.

sentences.zh: 從半入正，加活象限。

translations.literal: From half entering major, add the variable quadrant.
translations.idiomatic: From half to major, add the variable quadrant.

sentences.zh: 然後以前段晨昏轉積度減之。

translations.literal: Then subtract by the earlier segment's morning-evening rotation accumulated degree.
translations.idiomatic: Then subtract the earlier segment's morning-or-evening rotation accumulation.

sentences.zh: 若後段與前段接三交者，其內無從半入正，則加二氣象限，其內有從半入正，則加一活象限，一氣象限，以前段晨昏轉積度減之。

translations.literal: If later and earlier segments adjoin three nodes, if within there is no half entering major, then add two qi quadrants; if within there is half entering major, then add one variable quadrant and one qi quadrant, subtracting by the earlier segment's morning-evening rotation accumulated degree.
translations.idiomatic: If the later and earlier segments span three nodes: when no half-to-major transition occurs within, add two qi quadrants; when a half-to-major transition does occur within, add one variable quadrant and one qi quadrant; then subtract the earlier segment's morning-or-evening rotation accumulation.

sentences.zh: 推轉定積度 置晨昏入轉日，朔至弦，弦至望，用昏。

translations.literal: Derive fixed rotation accumulated degree: Set morning-evening rotation-entry day; new moon to quarter, quarter to full moon—use evening.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the fixed rotation accumulation: Set the morning-or-evening rotation-entry day. From new moon to quarter and from quarter to full moon, use evening.

sentences.zh: 望至弦， 弦至朔，用晨。

translations.literal: Full moon to quarter, quarter to new moon—use morning.
translations.idiomatic: From full moon to quarter and from quarter to new moon, use morning.

sentences.zh: 以前段減後段，不及減者，加二十八日減之，爲晨昏相距日。

translations.literal: Subtract the earlier segment from the later; if insufficient to subtract, add twenty-eight days and subtract—this is morning-evening separation day.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the earlier segment from the later; if subtraction fails, add twenty-eight days and subtract again to obtain the morning-and-evening separation in days.

sentences.zh: 從前段下，於鈐內驗晨昏相距日同者，取其轉定積度。

translations.literal: From under the earlier segment, within the register verify the same morning-evening separation day and take its fixed rotation accumulated degree.
translations.idiomatic: Under the earlier segment, look up the matching morning-and-evening separation day in the register and take its fixed rotation accumulation.

sentences.zh: 若朔弦望相距日少晨昏相距日一日者，則於晨昏相距日同者，取其轉積度，減去轉定極差一十四度七一五四，餘爲前段至後段轉定積度。

translations.literal: If new/first-quarter/full/last-quarter separation day is one day less than morning-evening separation day, then where morning-evening separation day matches, take its rotation accumulated degree, subtract the fixed rotation extreme difference of 14 degrees 7154—the remainder is the earlier-to-later segment fixed rotation accumulated degree.
translations.idiomatic: If the new-moon-to-quarter separation in days is one day shorter than the morning-and-evening separation, find the matching morning-and-evening separation day, take its rotation accumulation, subtract the fixed rotation extreme difference of 14°7154, and the remainder is the fixed rotation accumulation from the earlier to the later segment.

sentences.zh: ▲轉定積度鈐

translations.literal: ▲ Fixed rotation accumulated degree register
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Register of Fixed Rotation Accumulations

sentences.zh: 以下表格略

translations.literal: The table below is abbreviated.
translations.idiomatic: [Table below omitted.]

sentences.zh: 推加減差 以相距度與轉定積度相減爲實，以其朔弦望相距目爲法除之，所得視相距度多爲加差，少爲減差。

translations.literal: Derive addition-subtraction difference: Subtract fixed rotation accumulated degree from separation degree for dividend; divide by its new/first-quarter/full/last-quarter separation days for divisor; the quotient—if separation degree is greater, is addition difference; if less, is subtraction difference.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the addition-and-subtraction difference: Subtract the fixed rotation accumulation from the separation degree as dividend and divide by the number of days from new moon to quarter (or the corresponding interval) as divisor. If the separation exceeds the quotient's basis, the result is an addition difference; if less, a subtraction difference.

sentences.zh: 推每日太陰行定度 置朔弦望晨昏入轉日，視遲疾轉定度鈐日下轉定度，累日以加減差加減之，至所距日而止，即得。

translations.literal: Derive each day's fixed lunar daily motion: Set new/first-quarter/full/last-quarter morning-evening rotation-entry day; inspect the slow-rapid fixed rotation degree register under that day for fixed rotation degree; accumulate days adding and subtracting the addition-subtraction difference until the separation day—then obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the Moon's fixed daily motion: Set the morning-or-evening rotation-entry day at new moon, first quarter, full moon, or last quarter; take the fixed rotation degree under that day from the slow–rapid fixed-rotation register; accumulate day by day, adding or subtracting the addition-and-subtraction difference, until the separation day—the result is obtained.

sentences.zh: 推每日月離晨昏宿次 置朔弦望晨昏宿次，以每日太陰行度加之，滿月道宿次減之，即得。

translations.literal: Derive each day's morning-evening lunar-departure lodge position: Set new/first-quarter/full/last-quarter morning-evening lodge position; add each day's fixed lunar motion; when full of lunar-path lodge positions, subtract—then obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the lunar-departure lodge at morning and evening each day: Set the morning-or-evening lodge at new moon, first quarter, full moon, or last quarter; add the fixed daily lunar motion each day and, when the sum fills the lunar-path lodges, subtract—the lodge is obtained.

sentences.zh: ▲赤道十二宮界宿次

translations.literal: ▲ Equatorial twelve-palace boundary lodge positions
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Equatorial Twelve-Palace Boundary Lodges

sentences.zh: 表格略

translations.literal: Table abbreviated.
translations.idiomatic: [Table omitted.]

sentences.zh: 推月與赤道正交後宮界積度 視月道與赤道正交後，各宿積度宮界，某宿次在後，即以加之，便爲某宮正交後宮界積度。

translations.literal: Derive after-palace-boundary accumulated degree following moon's equatorial major-node crossing: Inspect after moon-path and equator major-node crossing each lodge's accumulated degree palace boundary; whichever lodge lies behind, add it—then it is that palace's after-major-node palace-boundary accumulated degree.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the accumulated degree after a palace boundary following the Moon's major equatorial node crossing: After the major crossing of the lunar path and equator, identify each lodge's accumulated degree at a palace boundary; add the lodge that lies next behind to obtain that palace's post-crossing boundary accumulation.

sentences.zh: 求次宮者，累加宮率二十度四三八一，滿氣象限去之，各得某宮下半產交後宮界積度。

translations.literal: To seek the next palace, cumulatively add palace rate 20 degrees 4381; when full remove the qi quadrant—each yields a palace's lower-half node-crossing after-palace-boundary accumulated degree.
translations.idiomatic: For the next palace, add the palace rate of 20°4381 cumulatively; discard the qi quadrant when full—each sum gives a palace's lower-half post-crossing boundary accumulation.

sentences.zh: 推宮界定積度 視宮界度在半象限已下爲初限，已上覆減氣象限，餘爲末限。

translations.literal: Derive palace-boundary fixed accumulated degree: Inspect palace-boundary degree—if below the half-quadrant it is initial limit; if above, subtract the qi quadrant in reversal—the remainder is terminal limit.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the fixed palace-boundary accumulation: If the boundary degree lies below the half-quadrant, it is the initial limit; if above, subtract the qi quadrant in reverse—the remainder is the terminal limit.

sentences.zh: 置某交定限度，與初末限相減、相乘，所得，千約之爲度，在正交、中交爲加差，在半交爲減差。

translations.literal: Set a certain node's fixed limit degree; subtract and multiply with initial and terminal limits; the product, reduced by a thousand for degrees—in major and middle nodes is addition difference; in half nodes is subtraction difference.
translations.idiomatic: Set the fixed limit degree for the node in question; subtract and multiply against the initial and terminal limits; scale the product by a thousand to degrees. At major and middle nodes this yields an addition difference; at half nodes, a subtraction difference.

sentences.zh: 置宮界正半中交後積度，以定差加減之，爲宮界定積度。

translations.literal: Set palace-boundary major-half-middle after accumulated degree; add and subtract by the fixed difference—this is palace-boundary fixed accumulated degree.
translations.idiomatic: Set the accumulated degree after the major, half, or middle palace boundary and add or subtract the fixed difference to obtain the fixed palace-boundary accumulation.

sentences.zh: 推宮界宿次 置宮界定積度，於月道內取其在所置前一宿者減之之不及減者，加氣象限減之。

translations.literal: Derive palace-boundary lodge position: Set palace-boundary fixed accumulated degree; within the lunar path take the lodge before the one set and subtract—if insufficient to subtract, add the qi quadrant and subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the palace-boundary lodge: Set the fixed palace-boundary accumulation; within the lunar path subtract the lodge immediately preceding the one placed—if subtraction fails, add the qi quadrant and subtract again.

sentences.zh: 推每月每日下交宮時刻 置每月宮界宿次，減入交宮日下月離晨昏宿次。

translations.literal: Derive each month each day's below-node palace time: Set the month's palace-boundary lodge position; subtract the lunar-departure morning-evening lodge position under the node-palace-entry day.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the time of palace entry below the node for each day of each month: Set the month's palace-boundary lodge and subtract the morning-or-evening lunar-departure lodge on the node-palace-entry day.

sentences.zh: 如不及減者，加宮界宿次前宿減之，餘以日周乘之，以其日太陰行定度而一，得數，又視定盈縮歷取立成日下晨昏分加之。

translations.literal: If insufficient to subtract, add the lodge before the palace-boundary lodge and subtract; the remainder multiply by day circuit; divide by one with that day's fixed lunar motion—obtain the number; again inspect the fixed expansion-contraction sequence and take the ready reckoner morning-evening fraction under the day and add.
translations.idiomatic: If subtraction fails, add the lodge before the palace-boundary lodge and subtract; multiply the remainder by the day circuit and divide by that day's fixed lunar motion; then look up the morning-and-evening fraction for the day in the fixed expansion–contraction ready reckoner and add it.

sentences.zh: 晨加晨分，昏加昏分。

translations.literal: Morning add morning fraction; evening add evening fraction.
translations.idiomatic: For morning, add the morning fraction; for evening, add the evening fraction.

sentences.zh: 如滿日周交宮在次日，不滿在本日，依發斂推之，即交宮時刻。

translations.literal: If full of day circuit the palace entry is on the next day; if not full, on this day—derive by emission-collection—then the node-palace time.
translations.idiomatic: If the sum fills the day circuit, palace entry falls on the next day; if not, on the current day. Apply the emission-and-collection procedure to obtain the time of node-palace entry.

sentences.zh: ▲步中星

translations.literal: ▲ Stepping culminating stars
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Stepping the Culminating Stars

sentences.zh: 推每日夜半赤道 置推到每日夜半黃道，見日躔。

translations.literal: Derive each day's midnight equator: Set the derived each-day midnight ecliptic—see Solar Progression.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the midnight equator for each day: Take the midnight ecliptic derived for each day (see Solar Progression).

sentences.zh: 依法以黃道積度減之，餘如黃道率而一，以加赤道積度。

translations.literal: By the method subtract ecliptic accumulated degree; the remainder divide by one with ecliptic ratio; add to equatorial accumulated degree.
translations.idiomatic: By the prescribed method subtract the ecliptic accumulation; divide the remainder by the ecliptic ratio and add the quotient to the equatorial accumulation.

sentences.zh: 又以天正科至赤道加之，如在春正後，再加一象限，夏至後加半周天，秋正後加三象限，爲每日夜半赤道積度。

translations.literal: Again add the celestial-origin seasonal-node equator; if after spring standard, again add one quadrant; after summer solstice add half circumpolar circuit; after autumn standard add three quadrants—this is each day's midnight equatorial accumulated degree.
translations.idiomatic: Add the equator at the celestial origin's seasonal nodes. After the spring standard add one quadrant; after the summer solstice add half a circumpolar circuit; after the autumn standard add three quadrants—the sum is each day's midnight equatorial accumulation.

sentences.zh: 推夜半赤道宿度 置夜半赤道度，以赤道宿度挨次減之，爲本日夜半赤道宿度。

translations.literal: Derive midnight equatorial lodge degree: Set midnight equatorial degree; subtract equatorial lodge degrees in succession—this is this day's midnight equatorial lodge degree.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the midnight equatorial lodge: Set the midnight equatorial degree and subtract successive equatorial lodge widths to obtain this day's midnight equatorial lodge.

sentences.zh: 推晨距度及更差度 置立成內每日晨分，以三百六十六度二十五分七十五秒乘之爲實，如日周而一，爲晨距度。

translations.literal: Derive morning separation degree and watch-interval difference degree: Set within the ready reckoner each day's morning fraction; multiply by 366 degrees 25 fen 75 miao for dividend; divide by one with day circuit—this is morning separation degree.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the morning separation degree and watch-interval difference: Take each day's morning fraction from the ready reckoner, multiply by 366°25′75″ as dividend, and divide by the day circuit to obtain the morning separation degree.

sentences.zh: 倍晨距度，以五除之，爲更差度。

translations.literal: Double the morning separation degree; divide by five—this is watch-interval difference degree.
translations.idiomatic: Double the morning separation degree and divide by five to obtain the watch-interval difference degree.

sentences.zh: 推每日夜半中星 置推到每日夜半赤道宿度，加半周天，即夜半中唾積度。

translations.literal: Derive each day's midnight culminating stars: Set the derived each-day midnight equatorial lodge degree; add half circumpolar circuit—this is midnight culminating accumulated degree.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the culminating stars at midnight each day: Set the midnight equatorial lodge derived for each day, add half a circumpolar circuit, and the sum is the midnight culminating accumulation.

sentences.zh: 以赤道度挨次減之，爲夜半中星宿度。

translations.literal: Subtract equatorial degrees in succession—this is midnight culminating-star lodge degree.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract successive equatorial lodge widths to obtain the midnight culminating-star lodge.

sentences.zh: 推昏旦中星置夜半中星積度，減晨距度，爲昏中星積度。

translations.literal: Derive dusk-and-dawn culminating stars: Set midnight culminating accumulated degree; subtract morning separation degree—this is dusk culminating accumulated degree.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to derive the dusk and dawn culminating stars: Set the midnight culminating accumulation and subtract the morning separation degree to obtain the dusk culminating accumulation.

sentences.zh: 以更差度累加之，爲遂更及旦中星積度。

translations.literal: Cumulatively add watch-interval difference degree—this is successive watches and dawn culminating accumulated degree.
translations.idiomatic: Add the watch-interval difference cumulatively to obtain the culminating accumulations for successive watches and for dawn.

sentences.zh: 俱滿赤道宿度去之，即得。

translations.literal: All when full of equatorial lodge degrees, remove—then obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever any sum fills the equatorial lodges, discard the circuit—the lodges are obtained.

sentences.zh: 以晨分五之一，加們爲更率。

translations.literal: Take one-fifth of the morning fraction and add to watches as watch rate.
translations.idiomatic: Take one-fifth of the morning fraction and add it to the watches to obtain the watch rate.

sentences.zh: 更率五而一爲點率。

translations.literal: Watch rate divided by five makes point rate.
translations.idiomatic: Divide the watch rate by five to obtain the point rate.

sentences.zh: 凡昏分，即一更一點，累加更率爲各更。

translations.literal: For all dusk fractions, that is one watch one point; cumulatively add watch rate for each watch.
translations.idiomatic: Each dusk fraction equals one watch and one point; add the watch rate cumulatively for successive watches.

sentences.zh: 凡交更即爲一點，累加點率爲各點。

translations.literal: For all watch changes that is one point; cumulatively add point rate for each point.
translations.idiomatic: Each change of watch equals one point; add the point rate cumulatively for successive points.
